article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết, tay chân miệng, COVID-19 gia tăng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever, hand-foot-mouth disease, and COVID-19 on the rise.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Ministry of Health reports April 2026 infectious-disease activity rising nationwide. Dengue fever: 6,408 cases and 1 death in April; since mid-December 2025, 44,965 cases and 5 deaths (up 1.8× in cases, 2× in deaths vs year ago). Hand-foot-mouth disease: 11,808 cases and 3 deaths in April; cumulative 34,432 cases, 8 deaths (about 2.5× higher). Influenza: 17,894 cases in April; no deaths; year-to-date 52,865, down 15.1% vs 2025. COVID-19: 302 cases in April; no deaths; cumulative 356 cases, 1 death (up 4.4×). Measles-like rash: 697 cases in April; no deaths; cumulative 3,127 (down 26.9×). Regional distribution: South 4,420 (63.2%), North 1,929 (27.5%), Central 530 (7.5%), Northwest 127 (1.8%). Notable: a 19-year-old dengue patient with obesity survived after three shock episodes within 24 hours in Vung Tau. Food poisoning: 7 outbreaks, 349 ill; Salmonella-linked outbreak in Ho Chi Minh City (185 on 8-4); 27 outbreaks since 18-12-2025, 849 ill, 3 deaths. May plan emphasizes enhanced surveillance, border/community monitoring, and stricter food-safety enforcement.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、手足口病、COVID-19が増加
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで複数の感染症（デング熱、手足口病、COVID-19など）の同時多発的な流行が報告されており、IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度（複数疾患での死亡例）と流行しやすさが確認される。
triage.notes: ベトナム保健省の公式報告であり、信頼性が高い。デング熱は前年比1.8倍の症例増加と2倍の死亡増加、手足口病は約2.5倍の増加を示しており、複合的な流行局面が形成されている。月間単位での詳細な地域別データも提供されており、監視体制が機能している。

article.articleHeadline: Multi-country outbreak of mpox, External situation report #65 - 30 April 2026
article.articleSummary: Mpox (MPXV) continues multi-country transmission, largely within sexual networks and households, with all clades circulating. By March 2026, 48 countries reported 1,235 confirmed cases and five deaths (CFR 0.4%), about 70% of cases in the WHO African Region. Outside Africa, declines occurred in the Americas, Africa, Europe and Southeast Asia, while the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific reported increases. In Africa, 16 countries had active transmission in the past six weeks (9 March–19 April 2026): 969 cases, three deaths (CFR 0.3%), led by Madagascar, DR Congo, Guinea, Kenya, and Burundi. First-time reports of clade Ib mpox were in Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador, Singapore, Argentina, Germany, Portugal, Spain, and the UK, including community transmission among men who have sex with men; Poland and Slovakia reported clade I pending subclade. Pakistan’s Sindh province reports a healthcare-associated mpox outbreak with 29 confirmed cases and eight deaths (CFR 28%), including many infants under six months.

triage.headline_ja: サル痘（Mpox）の多国間流行、外部状況報告書第65号 - 2026年4月30日
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡例・高いCFR）、予想外の医療関連アウトブレイク（パキスタン）、複数大陸への国際的拡大、渡航・貿易制限リスク。対象国DRCで活動的な伝播あり。
triage.notes: パキスタン（Sindh州）で医療関連の異常に高い致命率（CFR 28%）のアウトブレイク報告あり、対象国リストに該当なし。DRCは対象国として含める。記事は48カ国に影響する多国間流行を報告しており、IHR通知相当の複数基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết, tay chân miệng tăng trong tháng 4
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever and hand, foot, and mouth disease increase in April.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Ministry of Health reports April 2026 saw increases in dengue fever and hand–foot–mouth disease, with concurrent meningococcal meningitis and viral encephalitis activity. In April nationwide, dengue: 6,408 cases, 1 death; year-to-date through April about 45,000 cases and 5 deaths, up 1.8 times from 2025. Hand–foot–mouth disease: 11,808 cases and 3 deaths in April; cumulative 34,400 cases and 8 deaths, more than 2.5 times higher than 2025. Predominantly affects children 1–5. Lab results indicate circulation of Enterovirus 71 (EV71), a virulent strain linked to severe neurological complications. Meningococcal meningitis had 5 cases and 2 deaths in April; cumulative 26 cases and 4 deaths, higher than 2025. Viral encephalitis: 25 cases in April; cumulative 106 cases, 1 death. Influenza nearly 17,900 in April; measles-like rash 697; no deaths. Rabies: 20 deaths year-to-date, down 4. Authorities will continue close monitoring at communities and border gates to detect and respond quickly.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱と手足口病が4月に増加
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで複数の感染症が同時に発生し、デング熱と手足口病は前年比2.5倍以上の増加を示している。EV71株の確認と小児への影響が重大であり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: EV71株の検出と手足口病の著しい増加（前年比2.5倍以上）、小児の集中的な影響が懸念される。メニンゴコッカス髄膜炎も増加傾向。ベトナム保健省による継続監視体制が構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: 医生从患者身上拔出 17 只蜱虫！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctor Removes 17 Ticks From a Patient!
article.articleSummary: On May 1, 2026, doctors at Anhui Medical University Fourth Affiliated Hospital treated a severe bunyavirus infection (tick-borne disease) in a patient who developed fatigue, fever, and poor appetite after tick bites. Thirteen ticks were removed from the lower abdomen and chest/back, with four more found during hair cleansing. Ticks can embed painlessly; their mouthparts inject anesthetic, allowing feeding and growth from sesame-seed to soybean size. Early symptoms resemble influenza, with fever up to 40°C; prompt treatment is crucial. Do not forcibly pull ticks; use pointed tweezers to grasp the head and pull vertically, then disinfect and seek professional care if possible. Monitor 2–4 weeks for fever or rash. China CDC warns May Day holidays bring higher tick activity. Prevention during outdoor activity includes wearing light-colored long-sleeved shirts and pants, tucking pant legs into socks, avoiding sandals, applying DEET-based repellent, and inspecting scalp, ears, armpits, navel, and inner thighs after return.

triage.headline_ja: 医者が患者から17匹のダニを抜き出した！
triage.triage_reason: ダニ媒介性ブニヤウイルス感染症の個別症例報告であり、中国内の公衆衛生機関から発表されているが、現時点では集団発生（アウトブレイク）の証拠がなく、国際的拡大リスクの情報も不足。ただし季節的なダニ活動増加時期での感染警戒情報のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はダニ媒介感染症の個別症例と予防啓発であり、インフルエンザの集団発生ではない。見出しの「インフルエンザ」はBluedot APIの自動分類であるが、実際の疾患はダニ媒介ブニヤウイルス感染症である。中国CDCの季節的警戒情報があり、GW期間中の屋外活動時のダニ曝露リスク増加が背景。現時点で集団発生の報告はなく、単一患者の臨床症例。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura realiza drive-thru de vacinação contra chikungunya nesta sexta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall holds a drive-thru vaccination against chikungunya this Friday
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya drive-thru vaccination held in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, on International Workers’ Day (May 1, 2026) from 8:00 to 12:00 at the City Hall courtyard on Rua Coronel Ponciano. Part of COE strategies to fight an ongoing chikungunya epidemic; aims to increase vaccination access for adults 18–59 without contraindications, with a 3–5 minute pre-vaccination triage. Vaccine developed by Instituto Butantan in partnership with Valneva. Health Secretary Marcio Figueiredo notes low uptake at usual vaccination sites and positions the drive-thru as an option for working individuals. By May 1, Dourados reported 7,208 chikungunya notifications: 5,195 probable, 2,676 confirmed, 2,013 discarded, 2,519 under investigation; Reserva Indígena totals: 3,066 notifications, 2,427 probable, 1,708 confirmed, 639 discarded, 719 under investigation. Contraindications include pregnancy, immunosuppression, recent chemotherapy/radiation, BMI >30, acute fever; regular unit hours vary, with a plan to administer about 43,000 doses (~27% of target) over ~40 days.

triage.headline_ja: 市役所が金曜日にチクングニア熱予防接種のドライブスルーを実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで進行中のチクングニア熱流行への対応として予防接種キャンペーンが実施されている。流行の規模（ドゥアドス市で7,208件の報告）と継続的な対策の必要性は明らかだが、記事は主に予防接種施策の実施報告であり、新規の深刻な悪化や国際的拡大を示唆する情報が不明である。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱は既知の流行疾患であり、ブラジルにおける継続的な流行対応の報道。記事は予防接種戦略の実施についての通常的な公衆衛生情報である。流行の重症度と継続性は確認されるが、急速な悪化や国際的懸念を示すシグナルが特に認められないため、WATCHレベルで継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: 繼越南取證、泰國送審後！高端腸病毒 EV71 疫苗再向菲律賓提交新藥審查
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Following Vietnam's clearance and Thailand's submission for review! The high-end Enterovirus EV71 vaccine again submits for New Drug Application review in the Philippines.
article.articleSummary: Envacgen Enterovirus 71 vaccine (EV71) has formally filed a New Drug Application with the Philippine FDA, following approvals in Vietnam and a submission in Thailand; within a week, Southeast Asia saw two NDA filings for the high-end vaccine via strategic partners. In the Philippines, 2025 enterovirus outbreaks had nearly 40,000 cases by August, a more-than-sixfold YoY rise; roughly 1.36 million babies are born each year, and no EV71 vaccine is licensed locally. Envacgen could offer active immunization for children aged 2 months through under 6 years. Phase 3 multicenter trials reported 100% efficacy against circulating Southeast Asian genotypes and durable protection with antibodies lasting over five years; results published in Vaccines and peer-reviewed in The Lancet, with experts underscoring pre-exposure vaccination in 2–6 month-olds and durability after a third dose. Taiwan licensed Envacgen earlier; prospects include Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines NDA submissions.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの承認とタイの審査提出に続く！高性能腸病毒EV71ワクチンがフィリピンへの新薬審査を再度提出
triage.triage_reason: EV71ワクチンの規制承認プロセスに関する報道であり、直接的な感染症アウトブレイクではない。ただし、フィリピンの2025年腸病毒症例が前年比6倍以上増加（8月時点で約40,000例）という背景情報が含まれており、東南アジア地域の公衆衛生懸念を反映している。継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は医薬品承認申請に関するニュースであり、アウトブレイク報道ではない。ただし、フィリピンの2025年EV71症例が8月時点で約40,000例に達し前年比6倍以上増加している背景が記載されており、地域の流行状況を示す参考情報として価値がある。ワクチン開発・承認の進展状況は公衆衛生政策に関わるため、政府機関の関心は高い可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Orang Dewasa Kena Campak, Kondisi seperti Apa yang Perlu ke Dokter?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Adults Contract Measles: What Kind of Condition Requires a Doctor's Visit?
article.articleSummary: As of May 1, 2026, adults with measles should seek medical evaluation, per Dr. Erpryta Nurdia Tetrasiwi of Eka Hospital MT Haryono in Jakarta, Indonesia. Adults with measles should still see a doctor because complications can be numerous. During examination, clinicians assess the lungs to rule out pneumonia, one of the serious measles complications; they also check for potential secondary infections such as brain inflammation (encephalitis), heart problems, and even vision loss. If no secondary infection is found, patients may be discharged to isolate at home to prevent transmission. Treatment is symptom-driven: fever is managed with paracetamol; in severe cases, hospital admission is advised. Treatment is individualized; some patients with good immunity may require only about two days of hospital care.

triage.headline_ja: 大人が麻疹にかかった場合、医師の診察が必要な状態とは？
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャカルタ）での麻疹の事例報告であり、医療従事者による注意喚起的な記事。単一国での臨床的ガイダンス記事であり、爆発的な流行拡大や深刻な公衆衛生危機を示唆する情報は現在のところ確認できない。継続的なモニタリングが必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は医療専門家による臨床的なガイダンス記事であり、麻疹の急速な拡大や流行を示唆する疫学的データは提示されていない。記事は個別症例への対応方法に焦点を当てており、地域規模の公衆衛生上の危機を示唆していない。麻疹は感染しやすい疾患であるため、今後の続報によって判定が変わる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Científicos quieren frenar al dengue con drones: buscan detectar criaderos ocultos de mosquitos y prevenir enfermedades antes de que se propaguen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists want to curb dengue with drones: they aim to detect hidden mosquito breeding grounds and prevent diseases before they spread.
article.articleSummary: As part of a study spearheaded by Stanford University and tested in Makassar, Indonesia, drones with AI detect hidden breeding grounds of Aedes aegypti to prevent dengue, Zika, and chikungunya outbreaks. In a four-square-kilometer pilot, the drones detected nearly double the number of breeding sites compared with traditional ground inspections. The system uses high-resolution aerial cameras and AI models trained to recognize water-collecting objects such as discarded tires, buckets, and unused containers, including those on rooftops, inner courtyards, and in dense vegetation. This approach aims to bolster urban epidemiological surveillance, complementing house-to-house inspections, which are labor-intensive. Potential enhancements include multispectral sensors to identify additional water reservoirs and applicability across different climates. By addressing climate-change-driven expansion of Ae. aegypti, drone-based detection could be integrated into public health programs to anticipate and prevent widespread dengue outbreaks in dense cities.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者がドローンでデング熱を抑制したいと考えている：蚊の隠れた繁殖地を検出し、病気が蔓延する前に予防することを目指している
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（マカッサル）での蚊媒介性感染症（デング熱、ジカ、チクングニア）に関する技術的介入の研究報告であるが、実際の流行・患者発生を示すイベントではなく、予防目的のドローン検出システムの試験段階であるため、確立された流行シグナルとしての基準には合致しない。ただし、蚊媒介性感染症の潜在的リスク地域での取り組みとして情報価値があり、動向を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の感染症流行イベントではなく、スタンフォード大学とインドネシア（マカッサル）の共同研究による蚊媒介性感染症の予防技術の試験報告である。Aedes aegyptiの生息地検出に関する学術的・技術的な取り組みであり、緊急的な公衆衛生上の危機ではない。ただし、デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニアはいずれもWPRO地域で流行しやすい感染症であり、地域の感染症監視システムの進化を示すシグナルとして追跡する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil e África do Sul firmam memorando para ampliar cooperação agropecuária, combater febre aftosa e abrir caminho para mais comércio bilateral
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil and South Africa sign a memorandum of understanding to broaden agricultural and livestock cooperation, combat foot-and-mouth disease, and pave the way for greater bilateral trade.
article.articleSummary: Brazil and South Africa signed a Memorandum of Understanding to broaden agricultural and livestock cooperation, with emphasis on sanitary defense, fighting foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), prevention of animal diseases, technical exchange, and expanded bilateral trade. The agreement between Brazil's Ministry of Agriculture and Pecuária (MAPA) and South Africa's Department of Agriculture aims to deepen agropecuary cooperation, including a plan of action to tackle FMD through prevention, control, and eradication, with vaccination, post-vaccination surveillance, and field evidence generation, plus a regional focus on avian influenza within the sanitary agenda. South Africa seeks to adopt a regional approach to FMD inspired by Brazil, noting economic impacts from southern Africa. Brazil notes international recognition as FMD-free without vaccination by the OIE. The talks also target expanded trade in animal proteins and citrus fruits, and potential bilateral vaccination agreements and knowledge sharing to strengthen sanitary measures and regionalization for avian influenza.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルと南アフリカが農業協力覚書に署名、口蹄疫対策と二国間貿易拡大を推進
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫と鳥インフルエンザに関する二国間協力覚書の署名であり、疾病の制御・根絶を目指す政策的取組である。ただし実際の新規感染事例の報告ではなく、予防・対策協力に焦点があるため、情報不足により経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルが対象国リストに含まれるが、南アフリカは対象外のため verified_locations にはブラジルのみ列挙。本イベントは既存の感染症の制御・根絶に関する国際協力覚書であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。鳥インフルエンザと口蹄疫に関する予防・対策を重視しており、政府レベルの関心は高いが、直接的な感染事例や異常事象の報告を含まないため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Case filed against four doctors in Kerala over death of 7-year-old due to rabies
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, police filed an FIR against four doctors of Punalur Taluk Hospital and its superintendent after the death of seven-year-old Nia Faisal from rabies, despite vaccination. The child, from Kunnikod in Kollam district, was bitten by a stray dog on April 8, 2025. She received preventive treatment at Vilakkudi's Family Health Centre and the final dose scheduled for May 6, 2025. A fever preceded admission to Punalur Taluk Hospital and later Thiruvananthapuram SAT hospital, where rabies was laboratory-confirmed. She died May 5, 2025 during treatment at SAT. Police allege negligence in administering immunoglobulin; the superintendent is charged with providing inaccurate information under RTI and destroying evidence, while the doctors face charges of careless treatment. The Punalur First Class Judicial Magistrate Court directed the FIR following the mother's complaint, Habira.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州での狂犬病による7歳女児死亡事件で医師4人が告発
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡事例であり単独では深刻だが、本件は個別の医療過誤訴訟が主体で、公衆衛生上の流行リスクや異常性を示す証拠が記事には明示されていない。予防接種後の発症は医学的関心を呼ぶが、社会的関心は地域限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: 本件は狂犬病の単発死亡例であり、医療過誤に関する法的訴訟が主体である。記事には流行の兆候や複数感染者の報告はなく、地域的・個別的性質の強いケースと考えられる。狂犬病予防接種後の発症という医学的に注目すべき点があるが、公衆衛生上の危機的状況を示す情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm mùa đến sớm, nhiều ca nặng ở người bệnh nền và lưu ý khi "tự chẩn đoán" bằng AI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal flu arrives early, with many severe cases among people with underlying conditions, and caution about self-diagnosis using AI.
article.articleSummary: As of May 1, 2026, influenza season in northern Vietnam is arriving earlier than usual, with a notable rise in severe cases among patients with underlying conditions. Hospitals report patients presenting with chest tightness and shortness of breath requiring oxygen therapy or mechanical ventilation; fatalities have occurred in this high‑risk group. Typical influenza symptoms include high fever, headache, myalgia, plus respiratory signs such as runny nose and cough. Disease often progresses to severe illness around days 7–10; healthy individuals recover with symptomatic care, whereas those with comorbidities may experience prolonged fever and rapid respiratory deterioration. Vaccination is advised, with two seasonal peaks in Vietnam (May–Jul and Nov–Jan); optimal timing is March–April and October–November. High‑risk groups (age >65, pregnant women, people with diabetes, COPD, asthma, chronic liver disease) should receive yearly flu vaccine. Do not rely on AI for diagnosis or treatment; seek medical evaluation, and practice prevention (masks, hand hygiene, reduced crowd exposure).

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザが早期に到来、基礎疾患のある患者で重症例が多数発生、AI自己診断に関する注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザの早期流行と基礎疾患患者における重症化・死亡事例が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度）に該当するが、国内対応状況や外部支援の必要性に関する情報が不足しているため、続報を注視すべき段階と判定。
triage.notes: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性）しており、WPROスクリーニング基準でも4基準が該当している。早期到来、重症化、死亡事例という点で公衆衛生への懸念は明確。ただしベトナムの対応能力や国際的な支援必要性に関する具体的情報がないため、管理可能性が不明。通常のインフルエンザ流行であり国際的な拡大リスクは明記されていないが、重症化パターンと早期流行の報告により継続監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: New Coronavirus Found in Bats: Pandemic Risk? - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Kenyan scientists have identified a novel coronavirus in bats in Kenya, detected through ongoing wildlife surveillance. The virus can enter human cells via the ACE2 receptor, the same mechanism used by SARS-CoV-2, raising questions about spillover risk though no human infections have been reported. The Kenyan finding follows reports of HKU5-CoV-2 in bats in China, which also uses ACE2 for cell entry; again, no human cases to date. News outlets including Linfo.re, Le Monde, and Medisite.fr cover the surveillance-driven discovery. The U.S. CDC says there is currently no public health justification for concern, but monitoring continues. Researchers emphasize the importance of surveillance of bat populations and studying viral entry mechanisms to inform pandemic preparedness. A Nature article by Gallo et al. on alphacoronavirus receptors reinforces the need for vigilant surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コウモリで新規コロナウイルスが発見：パンデミックリスク？
triage.triage_reason: ケニアおよび中国でコウモリから新規コロナウイルスが検出されたシグナルだが、現在のところ人間感染報告がなく、米国CDCも懸念の公衆衛生上の正当化根拠がないと評価。ウイルス学的特性（ACE2受容体への親和性）は注視が必要だが、実在する脅威としての証拠は限定的。
triage.notes: ケニアおよび中国はいずれも対象国リストに含まれる（ケニアはGhanaの隣国だが GeoNames ID 192950で確認、中国は 1814991）。現段階では人間感染なく、米国CDCの評価も懸念不十分としているため、パンデミック脅威としての緊急性は低い。しかし、SARS-CoV-2と同じACE2機構を有する新規ウイルスの検出は、ウイルス学的監視と動物疾患サーベイランス強化の観点から継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: População de Dourados (MS) começa a receber vacina contra chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Residents of Dourados (MS) begin receiving the chikungunya vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Residents of Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, began chikungunya vaccination amid a local outbreak that led the municipality to declare a public health calamity. The 18–59 age group is targeted, with a drive-thru vaccination on May 1 from 8:00 to 12:00 at the Prefeitura de Dourados, aiming to immunize about 43,000 people (27% of the eligible population). As of 2026, Dourados reported 2,621 chikungunya cases and eight deaths, with one death under analysis. Nearly 60% of cases affect Indigenous residents; 21.3% White; 18% mixed-race (pardo). Contraindications include pregnancy or lactation, immunosuppression, congenital immunodeficiency, active cancer treatment, solid organ or bone marrow transplant within two years, HIV/AIDS, autoimmune diseases, and multiple chronic conditions. Also disqualifying are recent chikungunya infection within 30 days, fever, live attenuated vaccine within 28 days, or inactivated vaccine within 14 days. The effort aligns with Anvisa’s 2025 approval of a strategic vaccination plan covering about 20 municipalities in six states, as Brazil registered over 127,000 chikungunya cases and 125 deaths in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラドス市（MS州）の住民がチクングニア熱ワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで進行中のチクングニア熱流行に対する大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンの展開であり、IHR基準（異常性・公衆衛生影響）および WPRO基準（重症度・流行性・管理性）を満たす。国家レベルの対応と複数州での展開が報告されており、シグナル識別の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: ブラジルで2025年に127,000件以上のチクングニア熱症例と125人の死亡が報告されており、2026年のドゥラドス市での流行は進行中である。記事サマリーではHIVが疾患として挙げられているが、これはワクチンの禁忌（HIV/AIDS患者は接種対象外）の文脈での記載と考えられる。主たる感染症イベントはチクングニア熱である。

article.articleHeadline: 95 Persen Kasus Malaria Indonesia Terkonsentrasi di Papua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 95 percent of Indonesia's malaria cases are concentrated in Papua
article.articleSummary: 95% of Indonesia's malaria cases are concentrated in six Papuan provinces, with about 600,000 of an estimated 700,000 nationwide cases in 2025 occurring in Papua; outside Papua, roughly 32,000 cases are reported. Mimika District bears the heaviest burden, recording 190,597 cases in the previous year, about 27% of national malaria. To accelerate decline in Papua, the Ministry of Health implements the TOKEN (Temukan, Obati, Kendalikan) strategy. Cross-ministerial coordination led by the Deputy Ministers for Villages and Home Affairs and meetings with six Papuan governors aim to secure commitment for elimination. Despite 90% of Indonesians living in malaria-free areas, mobile migrant populations account for about 20% of cases, posing a risk of resurgence. Sporadic outbreaks (KLB) have been reported in areas previously malaria-free. As of now, 412 of 514 districts/cities are malaria-free, and seven provinces—Bali, Jakarta, Banten, West Java, East Java, Yogyakarta, South Sumatra—are entirely malaria-free. Continued migrant surveillance is essential to prevent reintroduction.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのマラリア症例の95%がパプアに集中
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける既知のマラリア流行の状況報告。公衆衛生への影響は深刻だが、突発的な新規アウトブレイク（異常性）は限定的。継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: インドネシア保健省がTOKEN戦略を実施中。パプア地域での高い疾病負荷（全国症例の約86%）が継続している。移住者集団による再発生リスクが指摘されており、散発的なアウトブレイク報告がある。既知の風土病状況の進捗報告であり、緊急シグナルではないが、パプア地域での感染動向と移住者関連リスク監視の継続が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Business.Scoop " New Approach Needed As Disease Spread Accelerates
article.articleSummary: West Pacific Tropics (WPT), including Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, and northern Australia (Far North Queensland and the Northern Territory's Top End), is identified as a high-risk region for the emergence of new infectious diseases. A James Cook University study led by Prof Bruce Gummow and PhD student Dr Emilia Lastica-Temura reviews 14 high-quality studies (2004–2024) to map how environmental, social and economic drivers interact across wildlife, domestic animals and people. Socioeconomic conditions and governance systems emerged as the most influential drivers shaping cross-boundary transmission pathways, with land-use change, wildlife trade and increasing wildlife–livestock contact central to pathogen spillover. Combined with climate vulnerability and dense species populations, these pressures create ideal conditions for disease spread. Researchers advocate a regional One Health approach—harmonising wildlife trade regulations and strengthening biosecurity via shared regional standards—to prevent outbreaks that could affect Australia. They acknowledge some bias due to study scarcity, but the trend is clear.

triage.headline_ja: 病気の蔓延が加速する中、新しいアプローチが必要
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は西太平洋熱帯地域における感染症出現リスクに関する学術的レビュー論文の紹介であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではなく、仮説的・予防的な議論である。現在進行中の具体的な患者発生や死亡事例の報告がない。
triage.notes: 記事はJames Cook大学の学術研究に基づいた感染症出現リスクに関する分析であり、「Unknown Illness」という不特定の疾患名が付与されているが、実際の患者発生イベントではなく予防的な地域分析である。インドネシアはサマリーで言及されているため verified_locations に含めたが、シグナル基準は満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: ತುಮಕೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಕ್ಕಿ ಜ್ವರದ ಆತಂಕ: ನವಿಲುಗಳ ಸಾವಿಗೆ 'H5N1' ಸೋಂಕು ಕಾರಣ!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu scare in Tumakuru: H5N1 infection is the cause of the peacocks' deaths!
article.articleSummary: On 1 May 2026, Tumakuru district, Karnataka, confirmed H5N1 avian influenza (bird flu) in peafowl deaths. Blood and organ samples tested at the Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL) confirmed H5N1. Initial suspicion of heat stress given 44 peacocks died within 11 days from 16 April, mostly around Bommanahalli and Machenahalli within a 1 km radius. Following confirmation, the Animal Husbandry department and district administration declared high alert. Five Rapid Response Teams have been deployed across five villages, each with one Public Information Officer, two veterinary department officers, and two forest department officers. A 10 km perimeter around Urdigere, Goulduru, Bommanahalli, and TG Palya is designated surveillance zone, with 33 villages under watch. Surrounding poultry farms will be tested for infection in chickens (nati), and farm access restricted. If chickens test positive, the situation could worsen. Farmers urged to report any deaths immediately.

triage.headline_ja: Tumakuru地区での鳥インフルエンザ警報：クジャクの死亡はH5N1感染が原因！
triage.triage_reason: カルナータカ州で確認されたH5N1鳥インフルエンザは異常・予想外の動物感染イベントであり、ヒト感染の可能性、拡大リスク、管理体制の必要性からスクリーニング基準複数に該当。社会的関心も高く、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはカルナータカ州Tumakuru地区での動物（クジャク）H5N1確認を述べており、対象国Indiaに該当。現段階ではヒト感染報告なし（影響カテゴリは'animals'）。ただし家禽での感染確認時に状況が悪化する可能性が指摘されており、潜在的なヒト感染リスクがある。5つのRRTが配置され、管理体制は機能している。

article.articleHeadline: Gia Lai ghi nhận ca mắc Whitmore đầu tiên năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gia Lai records its first Whitmore's disease case in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of May 1, 2026, Gia Lai Province, Vietnam, reports its first Whitmore’s disease case of 2026. The patient, Ksor H'P, 39, a farmer from Mook Trang village, Ia Dom commune, developed symptoms on 16 April that progressed to respiratory failure and septic shock. She was treated at Đức Cơ District Medical Center and then Gia Lai General Hospital, where laboratory tests confirmed Burkholderia pseudomallei, the causative agent of Whitmore. She remains on mechanical ventilation with a guarded prognosis. Exposure includes frequent contact with soil and muddy water from farming, living near forested areas, and river bathing—risk factors for infection. No additional community cases identified; authorities are conducting contact tracing and increasing public health messaging, advising PPE, limiting exposure to contaminated water, proper wound care, and prompt medical care for suspected cases. Whitmore is a severe, potentially fatal infection with 40–60% mortality.

triage.headline_ja: ギア・ライ省が2026年初のホイットモア病患者を記録
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシス（ホイットモア病）は重症度が高く（40-60%の死亡率）、スクリーニング基準の「重症度」に該当する。しかしベトナムでは過去に報告がある地域流行性疾患であり、今回は散発例（1例）の報告であり、国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す明確な証拠が不足している。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスはベトナムで地域流行性の疾患であり、ギア・ライ省での散発例報告は医学的には重症であるが、集団発生の兆候はない。当局は接触者追跡と公衆衛生啓発を実施中。情報源はベトナム公式メディア（VOV）であり政府の把握がある。今後の追加患者報告や地域拡大の有無を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Papua Sumbang 4 Persen Kasus TB, Wamenkes Benny Beberkan Tantangan Utama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Papua Accounts for 4 Percent of TB Cases, Deputy Health Minister Benny Reveals the Main Challenges
article.articleSummary: Papua accounts for 4% of Indonesia's national tuberculosis (TB) cases, according to Deputy Health Minister Benny Octavianus. The main challenges are low case finding and suboptimal household contact tracing, with many areas in Papua not meeting national TB case-finding targets. National TB service delivery coverage stands at 89.55%, indicating gaps in access and quality, particularly in Papua's geographically challenging areas. To address this, the government prioritizes aggressive screening and integrated contact tracing linked to the Free Health Check program, strengthened patient support to ensure complete treatment, real-time reporting integration, and involvement of cadres, families, and communities. Cross-sector collaboration is emphasized, including local government action through Regional Action Plans and the formation of a Regional TB Acceleration Team to direct and measure field interventions.

triage.headline_ja: パプアが結核症例の4パーセントを占める、ベニー保健副大臣が主な課題を明らかにする
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア国内のパプア地域における結核症例の報告であるが、IHR基準は2つ以上該当せず、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常/予想外性と管理可能性の観点で懸念があるものの、国家レベルの対応計画が示されており情報がやや不足している。
triage.notes: パプア地域における結核症例は国内的には既知の問題であり、国家保健当局による対応計画が既に進行中である。ただしサービス提供カバレッジが89.55%にとどまり、地理的障害が大きいパプア地域では特に課題が深刻である点は注視に値する。国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクは現時点では言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: महाराष्ट्रः नवापुर में बर्ड फ्लू का गहराया संकट, मारी जाएंगी 1.40 लाख मुर्गियां, 5 km तक बनाया बफर जोन
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maharashtra: Bird flu crisis deepens in Navapur; 140,000 chickens to be culled; buffer zone up to 5 km established.
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) confirmed in Navapur, Navapur taluka, Nandurbar district, Maharashtra, India. Samples from three poultry farms tested positive at Indore lab. About 140,000 chickens across six farms within a one-kilometer radius will be culled, starting today. A containment zone of 3 kilometers and a buffer zone up to 5 kilometers have been established around the affected area, with stricter action planned for negligent farm operators. Navapur hosts nearly 1 million chickens, raising spillover risk to nearby districts and Gujarat. Authorities issued guidelines on egg and chicken consumption and alerted other districts. Previous outbreaks in 2006 and 2021 led to large-scale culls and egg destruction.} }{}?}{

triage.triage_reason: インドの複数州（マハラシュトラ、グジャラート）での人獣共通感染症（鳥インフルエンザ）確認。14万羽規模の殺処分と隣接地域への感染拡大リスク、過去の大規模流行歴があり、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）とWPRO基準（重症度・流行性）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 鳥インフルエンザはヒト感染リスクがあり、記事では複数州での確認と隣接地域への拡大リスクが言及されている。140,000羽規模の殺処分、3-5km緩衝地帯の設定、過去2006年・2021年の大規模流行歴から、管理可能性が限定的である可能性がある。ナワプルに約100万羽の鶏が集中しており、地域経済への影響も懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi ramps up TB elimination drive, 9,432 cases identified
article.articleSummary: Delhi's TB elimination drive under TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan 2.0, aligned with NTEP and SDGs, targets TB elimination by 2030. From March 24 to April 30, 2026, 850 health camps across Delhi reached 65,264 people, with 46,950 chest X-rays and 21,683 NAAT tests, identifying 9,432 TB patients. A dedicated TB Diagnostic and Treatment Centre was inaugurated at Ayushman Arogya Mandir, Vikas Nagar in South-West Delhi, offering free NAAT testing and treatment. Early detection via sub-clinical screening and X-ray campaigns emphasized. Preventive treatment provided to 7,117 TB household contacts; Ni-kshay Mitra nutritional support reached 3,461 patients. Community engagement grew to 42 Ni-kshay Mitras; 127 elected representatives participated. The program highlights proactive outreach, rapid diagnosis, and patient support to curb transmission and meet the 2030 elimination goal.

triage.headline_ja: デリーがTB排除ドライブを拡大、9,432例を特定
triage.triage_reason: これは結核排除キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、新規の異常な感染症イベントではない。既知疾患の公衆衛生プログラム実施に関する肯定的なニュースであり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: このニュースはインドの結核排除プログラム（TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan 2.0）の進捗を報告する公式キャンペーン発表である。9,432例の特定は検出活動の結果であり、制御不能な流行や異常な発生状況ではない。むしろ計画的な保健介入の成果であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Lancement de la deuxième phase de vaccination contre la polio à Goma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Launch of the second phase of polio vaccination in Goma.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination campaign enters second phase in Goma, North Kivu, DRC. The second round was officially launched on April 30, 2026, in Goma, targeting children aged 0–59 months to bolster herd immunity amid the circulation of vaccine-derived poliovirus strains in the region. The effort covers 19 health zones, including Goma city and the Lubero, Masisi, Nyiragongo, and Rutshuru territories, not included in the first phase. A two-site approach was adopted: the Butembo site ran April 23–25; the Goma site runs from April 30 to May 2. Dr. Hans Batey, head of the Expanded Programme on Immunization in North Kivu, notes that proximity to Maniema—where cases have been notified—and the Walikale border increase vigilance. Authorities emphasize this campaign complements routine vaccination to protect newborns and young children against this disabling disease.

triage.headline_ja: ゴマでのポリオワクチン接種第2段階の開始
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン由来ポリオウイルス（VDPV）の循環により、DRCで大規模予防接種キャンペーンが実施されている。異常/予想外性、重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性のスクリーニング基準複数該当と高い社会的関心からシグナル対象。
triage.notes: VDPV循環に対応した大規模予防接種キャンペーンの展開。複数の北キブ州地区及びマニエマ州との国境地域での活動。ポリオは国際保健規則上の最優先疾患であり、VDPV検出と大規模対応実施はWHO通知基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam reports rise in dengue, hand-foot-mouth disease, COVID-19 cases
article.articleSummary: Vietnam reports rising dengue, HFMD and COVID-19 for Mar 18–Apr 18, 2026. Dengue: 6,408 cases and 1 death; cumulative since Dec 18, 2025: 44,965 cases and 5 deaths (up 1.8× YoY), with southern region hit hardest. Malaria 35; viral encephalitis 106 (1 death); meningococcal meningitis 26 (4 deaths). No Nipah, diphtheria, chikungunya, avian flu A/H5N1 or A/H9N2 or cholera in the month. triage.headline_ja: ベトナムがデング熱、手足口病、COVID-19の症例増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症について同時報告があり、デング熱とHFMDで前年比増加が顕著。ただし個別疾患としては重症度や国際的拡大リスクの明確な指標が不足しており、さらなる情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm mùa đến sớm, nhiều ca nặng ở người bệnh nền và lưu ý khi 'tự chẩn đoán' bằng AI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal influenza arrives early, with many severe cases among patients with underlying conditions, and caution about self-diagnosis with AI.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza has arrived earlier than usual in the northern region. Although the overall pattern remains typical for the season, many severe cases are reported among patients with underlying medical conditions, necessitating close clinical monitoring and timely intervention to prevent complications. The brief underscores the ongoing risk to high-risk groups as the early wave unfolds, and it highlights the importance of not relying on artificial intelligence for self-diagnosis, warning that AI-based assessments can mislead or delay proper care. Dated May 1, 2026, the report calls attention to an early-season influenza surge in the north and the need for vigilant management of vulnerable patients as the season progresses.

triage.headline_ja: 6,400人のデング熱患者が1ヶ月以上で報告、1人の死亡が確認
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで複数の感染症の多発生が同時に報告されており、デング熱を中心に前年比1.8倍の増加、手足口病は2.8倍の増加、複数の死亡が確認されている。IHR基準で異常性と公衆衛生への影響が認められ、シグナル特性を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムにおけるデング熱、手足口病、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎、COVID-19、肝炎、食中毒など複数の感染症の同時多発生を報告。デング熱は過去1ヶ月間で6,400ケース、累積45,900ケースで前年比1.8倍。手足口病は2.8倍増。複数の疾患で死亡者が確認されている。これはシグナル特性を満たすレベルの多疾患同時流行である。

article.articleHeadline: Poliovirus strain detected in WA for the first time
article.articleSummary: Vaccine-derived poliovirus was detected in wastewater at the Subiaco wastewater treatment plant in Western Australia—the first detection in Australia, which has been polio-free since 2000 and does not use the oral vaccine. The finding is an environmental signal with very low immediate risk; no clinical cases or local transmission have been identified. The Australian Centre for Disease Control, the National Polio Surveillance Program and advisory groups are coordinating the response. The virus likely originated from someone who lived overseas and travelled to Perth. Wastewater surveillance provides early warning and, at this stage, there is no evidence of spread. Regions with outbreaks recently include the Philippines, Indonesia and PNG; the virus may derive from mutated oral vaccine strains or naturally circulating virus in Pakistan/Afghanistan. Childhood vaccination coverage in WA is about 92%.

triage.headline_ja: ポリオウイルス株がオーストラリア（西オーストラリア州）で初めて検出
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン由来ポリオウイルスの環境検出は異常・予想外であり、IHR基準2項目以上に該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の重要な信号として、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは西オーストラリア州での環境検出が主題だが、オーストラリアは対象国リストに含まれていない。パキスタン、アフガニスタンへの言及があるが、対象国リストに未含録。フィリピン、インドネシア、パプアニューギニアの最近のアウトブレイク地域への言及から、WPRO地域全体での公衆衛生的懸念が存在する。臨床症例はなく環境信号レベルであるが、ポリオ根絶達成国での初検出は極めて重要な信号。

article.articleHeadline: महाराष्ट्र में बर्ड फ्लू ने तबाही मचाईः 1.40 लाख मुर्गियों को मारने का आदेश, 5 km तक बनाया बफर जोन - Lalluram
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu ravaged Maharashtra: Order to cull 140,000 chickens, buffer zone up to 5 km - Lalluram.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) has been confirmed at a Navapur poultry farm in Nandurbar district, Maharashtra, triggering mass culling and containment measures. About 140,000 chickens across six farms within a one-kilometer radius will be culled, with culling starting today. A 3-kilometer containment zone and a 5-kilometer buffer zone are being established around the outbreak to prevent spread. Navapur lies near the Gujarat border and reportedly houses around 1 million chickens, heightening regional risk. Authorities advise against consuming eggs and chicken from the affected area. The administration has pledged support for affected farms under regulatory provisions and will take strict action against operators found negligent. Maharashtra has faced similar outbreaks in 2006 and 2021, which led to mass poultry losses and egg destruction.

triage.headline_ja: マハーラシュトラ州で鳥インフルエンザが猛威：14万羽のニワトリ殺処分命令、5km緩衝地帯設置
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・予想外性が確認され、鳥インフルエンザ（H5N1関連）の人獣共通感染リスク、および大規模な家畜影響（14万羽の殺処分）が認められるため、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはマハーラシュトラ州ナンドゥルバル地区ナーワプルでの鳥インフルエンザ確認を主題としており、インド国内での発生であることが明確。100万羽規模の養鶏地域での限定的爆発だが、人獣共通感染リスクと家畜影響の両面で懸念あり。過去の類似事例（2006年、2021年）との比較記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: उत्तराखंड में स्वाइन फ्लू को लेकर पशुपालन विभाग सतर्क, एकमात्र फार्म में बाहरी लोगों की एंट्री बैन - kumaon swine flu alert animal husbandry dept on high alert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uttarakhand swine flu alert; Animal Husbandry Department on high alert; outsiders barred from entering the only farm
article.articleSummary: As of May 1, 2026, Uttarakhand’s Animal Husbandry Department has heightened swine-flu surveillance at Kumaon division’s only pig farm in Kashipur. The facility houses four boars, 40 sows, and 56 piglets. External entry is barred to protect the stock; suspected cases trigger sampling for laboratory testing. Officials report no confirmed swine-flu virus in the division yet. Swine flu can spread from pigs to humans, particularly those with weakened immunity. Dr. Ramesh Nitwal, Kumaon Additional Director of Animal Husbandry, said inspection teams were deployed after recent visits to the Kashipur farm; samples are sent to the Indian Veterinary Research Institute (IVRI) for testing. If a sample tests positive, it will be sent to a High-Security Lab in Bhopal for confirmation. Ongoing surveillance and testing continue.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタラカンド州で豚インフルエンザ警戒; 動物畜産局が厳重警戒; 唯一の養豚場への外部者の立ち入り禁止
triage.triage_reason: 豚インフルエンザの動物での検出前段階であり、現在のところ人への確定症例は報告されていない。ただし動物での流行リスク、人への伝播可能性、サーベイランス強化が進行中のため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は動物での豚インフルエンザ検査段階であり、現在のところ人への確定症例なし。ただし人への伝播可能性（免疫低下者への懸念）があり、IVRI及びBhopalの高度セキュリティ施設での検査が進行中。動物サーベイランスと継続的検査により管理されている。確定症例の報告があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dozens fall ill after eating bread in Quảng Trị
article.articleSummary: Dozens of suspected food-poisoning cases in Quảng Trị Province, Vietnam, linked to bread purchased from a bakery in Tân Sơn Hamlet, Tân Lập Commune, Hướng Hóa District. A total of 46 patients were admitted from about 6:30am on April 29 through the morning of May 1, 2026. Most patients are pupils at Hướng Lộc Ethnic Boarding Primary and Lower Secondary School; ages span from 50 months to 46 years, with the majority aged 11–15. Symptoms include high fever, repeated loose stools, vomiting, intermittent abdominal cramps, fatigue and dehydration. Treatments involve intravenous fluids, oral rehydration, antibiotics, and intensive care as needed; all cases are currently stable with no severe outcomes reported. Authorities held an emergency meeting; health inspectors collected samples, zoned off the area, and monitored public sentiment, coordinating with police and schools to investigate the suspected infection source and protect at-risk pupils.

triage.headline_ja: クアンチ省でパン摂取後に数十人が発病
triage.triage_reason: 異常性と重症度の基準を満たし、学校集団発症による公衆衛生上の懸念がある。規模は限定的だが、感染源特定と拡大防止のための介入が必要。
triage.notes: 食中毒事案として46名の患者が特定され、学校集団発症の形態。多くが児童・生徒（11-15歳中心）。患者は全て安定状態で重症者なし。感染源（ベーカリー）の調査と監視体制が確立。Unknown Illnessの分類だが、サマリーから食中毒（suspected food-poisoning）の可能性が高い。地域検証確認済み：ベトナム（Quảng Trị Province）が主要な発生地域。

article.articleHeadline: [Kolom Pakar] Prof Tjandra Yoga Aditama: Tuberkulosis dan Perempuan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Expert Column] Prof Tjandra Yoga Aditama: Tuberculosis and Women
article.articleSummary: During World TB Day in South Jakarta, Indonesia, on 30 April 2026, Prof. Tjandra Yoga Aditama outlined TB control themes and five key TB topics: discovery of the TB bacterium, global and Indonesian epidemiology, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention. The event, hosted by Puskesmas Cilandak, targeted female TB cadres and highlighted gender dimensions per the WHO Global TB Report 2025. Global data show TB patients are 35% women and 11% children/adolescents, with men constituting 54%. In Indonesia, TB cases are 2.3 times higher among men than women. Across 31 high-burden countries, treatment success is slightly higher among women and girls (90%) than among men and boys (87%). The session emphasized reducing stigma and applying the 'Prevention, Treatment, and Support' approach to TB care.

triage.headline_ja: 【専門家コラム】チャンドラ・ヨガ・アディタマ教授：結核と女性
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2026年4月30日のWorld TB Dayイベントにおける教育・啓発活動の報告であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルではない。既知の疾患に関する専門家による統計情報と予防啓発が主題であり、緊急性のある健康危機を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは既知の結核に関する啓発・教育活動であり、新規患者の急増、異常な感染拡大、または管理不可能な状況を示す証拠がない。記事は統計情報の共有と性別別の影響に関する認識向上を目的としており、アウトブレイク検出（EBS）の対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Maharashtra Bird Flu: महाराष्ट्र के नवापुर में बर्ड फ्लू का कहर; 1.40 लाख मुर्गियां मारी जाएंगी, 5 किमी तक बफर जोन घोषित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maharashtra Bird Flu: Bird flu wreaks havoc in Navapur, Maharashtra; 140,000 chickens will be culled, buffer zone up to 5 km declared.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) outbreak in Navapur, Nandurbar district, Maharashtra, after three poultry farms tested positive in Indore laboratory, with suspect deaths on 12–13 April. About 140,000 chickens across six farms within a 1 km radius will be culled, starting May 1, 2026. A 3 km containment zone and a 5 km buffer zone are being established around Navapur; the Gujarat-adjacent area contains roughly 1 million chickens, indicating risk of wider spread. District collector Mittali Sethi announced strict action against negligent farm operators and government aid to affected farms per rules. Authorities urge adherence to official guidance on chicken and egg consumption. The situation follows previous Navapur outbreaks in 2006 and 2021, which also led to large-scale culling and egg destruction.

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ州の鳥インフルエンザ：ナワプルで鳥インフルエンザが猛威を振るう；14万羽の鶏が殺処分される予定、5km までのバッファゾーンが宣言される
triage.triage_reason: インドで鳥インフルエンザの集団発生が確認され、14万羽の大規模な殺処分、複数州にまたがる感染リスク、および反復的な発生パターンが認められ、IHR基準とWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にインド（マハラシュトラ州ナワプルおよびマディヤプラデシュ州インドール）における鳥インフルエンザの集団発生を記述。ギジャラート州隣接地域に約100万羽の鶏が存在し、州間での拡大リスクが高い。過去の発生履歴（2006年、2021年）から反復的なパターンが示唆される。影響カテゴリは「animals」とされているが、公衆衛生への潜在的インパクト（食品安全、鶏肉・卵消費に関する公衆衛生ガイダンス）があり、ヒト感染の可能性は現時点では記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC warns of cross-border spread of Mpox, Cholera
article.articleSummary: Mpox and cholera hotspots in Africa are increasingly crossing borders, Africa CDC warns. About 85% of confirmed Mpox cases are concentrated in Madagascar, Guinea, Kenya and Liberia, with Madagascar most affected due to sustained human-to-human transmission. Cross-border movement and weak monitoring drive regional spread; Mauritius reported travel-linked Mpox cases, highlighting surveillance gaps. Cholera deaths remain high even as overall case numbers decline; the case fatality rate stands around 2.2%, above the global target of 1%. DR Congo and Mozambique are hardest-hit for cholera, while Angola, Burundi and the Republic of Congo show emerging outbreaks linked to poor water and sanitation. More than 5 million Mpox vaccine doses have been distributed to 19 countries, with vaccination ongoing in at least 15. Africa CDC plans stronger cross-border surveillance, vaccine deployment, and emergency coordination, plus investments in water, sanitation, and disease monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがサル痘とコレラの国境を越えた拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で4つ該当（異常性・重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）、アフリカ地域での複数疾患同時流行で公衆衛生的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事では複数のアフリカ諸国が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Madagascar、Guinea、Kenya、Liberia、Mauritius、Angola、Burundi、Republic of Congoは対象国外であるため除外。ただし、アフリカ地域全体での複数疾患同時流行、高い致死率（コレラ2.2%）、国境を越えた拡大の警告、Africa CDCによる緊急対応計画により、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Urban Vector Risks Under Focus - BW Healthcare World
article.articleSummary: Urban vector-borne disease risk in Indian cities centers on dengue, malaria and chikungunya amid rapid urbanisation, climate variability and high density. A national technical conclave in Ahmedabad (28–29 April 2026) organised by ISMOCD, Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation and Envu India emphasized science-led, integrated vector management and cross-sector collaboration to bolster prevention, surveillance and capacity building. Key themes include AI-assisted analysis of ovitrap surveillance, WHO-aligned Integrated Vector Management, and strengthening Urban Malaria Scheme and National Urban Health Mission. Data highlighted inefficiencies in conventional methods; Delhi’s fogging season reportedly uses about 450,000 litres of diesel with 5% insecticide, prompting a shift toward sustainable, breeding-cycle interventions. Experts advocate enhanced academia-government partnerships, interdisciplinary training, and field-based learning. While malaria deaths have declined since independence and kala-azar and lymphatic filariasis have fallen, elimination targets for malaria, lymphatic filariasis and kala-azar by 2030 require stronger collaboration and innovation, especially in urban areas.

triage.headline_ja: 都市部のベクター媒介感染症リスクが焦点に - BW Healthcare World
triage.triage_reason: インドの都市部における複数のベクター媒介感染症（デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア）に関する学術的・政策的な検討会議の記事。既存の流行状況の分析と対策強化の議論が中心であり、新規発生や急速な拡大の報告ではないが、スクリーニング基準複数該当と政策的関心の高さから経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は技術会議・政策検討が主題で、新規流行報告ではなく既知の課題への対策強化の議論。ただし都市部でのデング熱・マラリア・チクングニアが継続的な公衆衛生上の懸念として位置付けられており、政府レベルでの対応が進行中。インド国内の複数州（グジャラート州、デリー）での取り組みが報告されている。IHR基準は2つ以上に該当していないが、WPRO基準で複数該当し、政府的関心が高いため、WATCH判定が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Cả nước ghi nhận 44.965 trường hợp mắc sốt xuất huyết, 5 ca tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The country records 44,965 dengue fever cases, 5 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Vietnam continues to surge with 44,965 cases and 5 deaths recorded since December 14, 2025. In April 2026 alone, 6,408 cases and 1 death were reported. With the monsoon season approaching and warm, humid conditions, transmission is expected to rise in multiple provinces, and several localities are experiencing upward trends. The Ministry of Health notes ongoing preventive work, including finalizing a decree detailing parts of the 2025 Prevention Law and soliciting legal opinions; it is also refining circulars on disease surveillance, reporting, and vaccination. The health sector is coordinating with local authorities to monitor and contain outbreaks and to intensify community risk communication. Public messages urge households to eliminate mosquito breeding sites and practice personal protection. A Pan American Health Organization director warns dengue now reflects climate-change impacts and may reach record levels in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 全国でデング熱患者44,965人を記録、5人死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのデング熱の急速な増加（年初来44,965例、5死亡）と季節的なリスク上昇が報告されており、IHR基準2項目以上に該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と地域内での流行リスクが認識される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはベトナム全国でのデング熱流行を主題とし、公式統計（44,965例、5死亡）を引用。モンスーン季節の接近による感染拡大予測、複数県での上昇傾向、保健省による予防対策強化などが記載されている。PAHOディレクターの気候変動との関連指摘により、国際的な関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bangladesh Measles Outbreak: বাংলাদেশে হামের প্রকোপ, ২৫০-র বেশি মৃত্যু! বেশিরভাগই শিশু, WHO-র রেড অ্যালার্ট
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangladesh Measles Outbreak: Measles Outbreak in Bangladesh, Over 250 Deaths! Mostly Children, WHO's Red Alert.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh has claimed over 250 lives, mostly children, prompting a WHO red alert. The rapidly worsening situation heightens South Asia health risks as open India–Bangladesh borders and frequent cross-border travel could enable spread to India. Vaccination gaps are identified as a major driver of transmission. While India faces potential exposure, its robust vaccination program lowers the likelihood of a large crisis, but border districts require heightened vigilance and regular surveillance for imported cases. The report emphasizes measles’ high contagion and calls for expanded immunization coverage and cross-border public health measures to curb regional transmission as of May 1, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュの麻疹アウトブレイク：250人以上の死亡、WHO赤アラート
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニングでも複数基準該当し、社会的関心も高い。麻疹は高感染性で国境を越えた地域的脅威を呈している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではバングラデシュでの麻疹アウトブレイク（250人以上死亡）とそのインドへの波及リスクについて述べられている。Bluedot APIが指摘するバングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。インドは対象国であり、記事内で「India faces potential exposure」と明記されているため対象国として列挙。WHO赤アラート、高い死亡率、予防接種格差、国境を越えた伝播リスク等、複数の危機管理要素が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: One Squirrel Terrorises Entire University In Rajasthan, Bites 20 People
article.articleSummary: As of 1 May 2026, Mohanlal Sukhadia University (MLSU) in Udaipur, Rajasthan reports a six-week incident in which a 'rogue' squirrel has bitten nearly 20 people on the Arts College campus, including the college dean. The attacks center around the Psychology Department, where witnesses say the animal nests and defends its territory. The Animal Aid rescue team has been deployed twice without success, and authorities have been advised to be alerted whenever the squirrel is spotted. Health guidance notes that squirrel bites do not carry a rabies risk, but a tetanus injection is advised as a precaution. No laboratory confirmation or imported/exported cases are mentioned. The episode has spurred safety measures on campus, with ongoing concerns about animal behavior and campus access.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州の大学でリスが20人を咬傷 - テロ行為のような動物の攻撃事件
triage.triage_reason: リスの咬傷による散発事件であり、公開情報で「狂犬病リスクなし」と明記され、破傷風予防接種が推奨されているのみ。感染症アウトブレイク（集団発症）ではなく、野生動物との接触事故であるため、IHRスクリーニング基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症イベントではなく、野生動物（リス）による物理的外傷事件である。記事サマリーで明確に『狂犬病リスクなし』と記載され、破傷風予防は標準的な外傷対応。20人の咬傷も6週間にわたる散発事件であり、急速な感染症伝播・アウトブレイクの兆候はない。動物福祉および大学キャンパス安全の問題であり、感染症危機管理の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Dozens fall ill after eating bread in Quang Tri, Vietnam
article.articleSummary: Dozens in Quang Tri, Vietnam, hospitalized with suspected food poisoning after consuming bread from a bakery in Tan Son Hamlet, Tan Lap Commune. From Apr 29 to May 1, 46 patients were admitted to Huong Hoa Regional General Hospital with high fever, repeated loose stools, vomiting, abdominal cramps, fatigue and dehydration; ages ranged from 50 months to 46 years, with the majority students aged 11–15 from Huong Loc Ethnic Boarding Primary and Lower Secondary School (hamlets Ra Ty, Pa Xia, Cua). Treatments include IV fluids, oral rehydration, antibiotics; all cases stable, no severe illness. Local authorities held an emergency meeting, collected samples, zoned off affected area, and coordinated with police and health agencies; schools were reviewed and monitoring ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム・クアンチ省でパンの摂取後に数十人が患者発生
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒の可能性が高い局所的イベントであり、IHR基準は2つ未満、WPRO基準で「重症度」と「管理可能性」に該当の可能性があるが、死亡や重症例がなく国際拡大リスクは低いため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 疾患は「Unknown Illness」で特定されていないが、記事サマリーから食中毒（おそらく細菌感染症）の特徴的な症状群が報告されている。46名が入院したが全員病状は安定しており、重症例や死亡例はない。発生源は特定済み（ベーカリー）で、地方当局による対応も進行中。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められない。スクリーニング基準「epidemic_prone」「manageability」に該当するが、重症度がなく公開による大きな社会的関心も示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Tự ý bôi cao nóng vào vết xước, người đàn ông bị nhiễm trùng huyết nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man develops severe sepsis after self-applying hot ointment to a scratch.
article.articleSummary: Two sepsis cases linked to self-treatment and silicone allergy were reported in Vietnam on 2026-05-01. In Quảng Ninh, a 54-year-old man self-treated a minor scratch with a hot ointment, leading to severe infection in the right foot (with multiple blisters and purple skin) and cellulitis in the left leg; laboratory tests confirmed septicemia. He received prompt antibiotics, debridement of the right-foot wound, and intensive wound care to prevent spread and possible surgical intervention. Clinicians warned that applying hot ointment to an open wound likely worsened tissue injury and facilitated bacterial invasion. In Sơn La, a 38-year-old man presented with widespread blistering, darkened skin, sore throat, oral ulcers, temporary vision loss, and high fever, progressing to sepsis with liver and kidney failure attributed to silicone allergy. The report underscores risks from improper home remedies and silicone-related reactions as potential sources of life-threatening infection.

triage.headline_ja: 男性が搔き傷に熱軟膏を自己塗布して重度の敗血症を発症
triage.triage_reason: Unknown Illness分類であり、報告された2症例は自己治療の不適切さと物質アレルギーに起因する散発的な医療事故。伝染性疾患の集団発生の兆候なく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威性は低い。
triage.notes: 報告は医療教育的な事例報告（self-treatmentの危険性とsilicone allergyの警告）であり、感染症のシグナルではなく個別の医療事故。敗血症は深刻だが、伝播の可能性なく、疾患分類が『Unknown Illness』のままであることも情報不足を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC raises alarm as mpox, cholera spread across borders
article.articleSummary: Mpox transmission in Africa is shifting across borders, with 85% of confirmed mpox cases in Madagascar, Guinea, Kenya, and Liberia; Madagascar remains the primary hotspot with ongoing transmission. Guinea, Kenya and Liberia report low case counts. Cholera cases have declined versus prior years, but the fatality rate remains about 2.2%. DRC and Mozambique are major contributors, about 59% and 21% of cases and deaths, with DRC driving fatalities. Emerging outbreaks appear in Angola, Burundi, and Republic of Congo, linked to poor water and sanitation and environmental disruptions. Angola shows 44% without safe drinking water and 55% without adequate sanitation; outbreaks shift to new locations despite interventions. Africa CDC is strengthening cross-border surveillance, vaccination deployment (over 5 million mpox vaccine doses to 19 countries; ongoing in at least 15 states), and urges investments in WASH and disease surveillance to curb transmission. As of 1 May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがMpoxとコレラの国境を越えた拡大に警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当し、複数国での多疾患同時流行、高い死亡率、国際的な対応が展開されている。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全項目該当。
triage.notes: Bluedotが列挙した地域のうち、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。マダガスカル、アンゴラ、モザンビーク、ケニア、リベリア、ブルンジ、ギニアは対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事は複数国での流行を述べているが、トリアージ対象となる検証済み地域はDRCのみ。DRCは事例の59%とコレラ死亡例の主要寄与国として明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: В Приморье обнаружили опасную курятину из Китая
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Primorye, dangerous chicken meat from China was found.
article.articleSummary: In Primorye, a large batch of chicken drumsticks from China, exceeding 27 tons, was found contaminated with Salmonella. Vladivostok authorities, through RosselkhozNadzor, ordered withdrawal from circulation after a sample taken at inbound control at a temporary storage warehouse in Vladivostok tested positive and was laboratory-confirmed. The discovery indicates gross violations of manufacturing, storage temperatures, transport and sale conditions, and suggests non-compliance with sanitary norms at the producer. Salmonella is unusually hardy, surviving freezing and multiplying with minor temperature increases; only thorough heat treatment—boiling or frying until fully cooked—ensures safety. The authorities will decide the fate of the batch. This year marks the third time Salmonella has been detected in imported meat products in Russia.

triage.headline_ja: プリモルスキー地方で中国からの危険な鶏肉が発見された
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはSalmonella汚染した食品（鶏肉）の単一検出事例であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の主要な条件を満たさない。人間への発症報告がなく、食品汚染の早期発見・排除により公衆衛生への深刻な影響は回避されている。
triage.notes: 本記事はロシア（Primorskiy Kray/Vladivostok）における輸入食品（中国産）の汚染検出に関するものであり、対象国リストに該当する国での感染症イベント発生ではない。Salmonellaは食品由来疾患の病原体だが、本件は食品検査段階での検出であり、人間への集団感染事例ではない。通常のルーチン検査の枠内での対応と考えられ、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: மாமல்லபுரத்தில் சொறிநாய்கள் அதிகரிப்பு- சுற்றுலா பயணிகள் அச்சம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in stray dogs in Mamallapuram - Tourists worried.
article.articleSummary: As of May 1, 2026, Mamallapuram's urban area reports a rise in stray dogs, with more than 100 animals showing widespread mange-like skin lesions and foul odor, alarming tourists. The affected zones include the coastal precincts near the Shore Temple, Arjuna's Penance, the Butter Ball Rock, Pidari Ratham, and Pulikugai areas, where dense canine populations roam. Domestic and international visitors express fear and discomfort as they visit these historic sites, with social media comments questioning the destination's safety. Local authorities—the Mamallapuram Municipality and the veterinary department—are urged to implement dog population control and relocate mange-infected dogs to protect visitors and residents. The situation highlights public health concerns about animal welfare, zoonotic risk, and the management of stray dogs in tourist hotspots during the hot summer.

triage.headline_ja: ママッラプラムの野犬増加 - 観光客が懸念
triage.triage_reason: Unknown Illnessとして分類されており、野犬の皮膚病変（疥癬様）が報告されているが、具体的な病原体特定がなく情報不足。ただし人獣共通感染症リスク（zoonotic risk）への言及と観光地での公衆衛生懸念があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 疾患が『Unknown Illness』と分類されており、具体的な病原体が不明。記事は主にママッラプラム（タミルナドゥ州）の野犬における皮膚病変について報告。人獣共通感染症リスクの言及あり。観光客の懸念と社会メディアでの議論あり。より詳細な病因確認と感染者報告がなければ公衆衛生緊急事態とは判定難い段階だが、動物由来感染症の可能性に注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kaltim: Pemberian vaksinasi dengue efektif tekan kasus DBD - ANTARA News Kalimantan Timur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Kalimantan Health Office: Dengue vaccination administration is effective in reducing dengue fever cases - ANTARA News East Kalimantan
article.articleSummary: Dengue vaccination in East Kalimantan (Kalimantan Timur), Indonesia, initiated in 2024, is linked to a notable drop in dengue fever (DBD) cases across the region, including Balikpapan, Samarinda, and Mahakam Ulu. East Kalimantan Health Office head Jaya Mualimin reports that among thousands of vaccinated elementary students, there are no dengue infections observed post-immunization. Dengue previously exhibited three- to five-year cycles with seasonal surges, peaking in Benua Etam from November to February, underscoring the need for sustained interventions. Mortality from Aedes aegypti–related dengue infections has also declined steadily in recent years. The program emphasizes expanding vaccination coverage, robust public education, and cross-sector collaboration to ensure complete dosage. Current data show 231 cumulative dengue cases in Kalimantan Timur, with Samarinda the highest at 46. Authorities aim to keep mortality under 0.4% by strengthening medical referral systems.

triage.headline_ja: 東カリマンタン保健局：デング熱ワクチン接種はデング熱症例削減に有効
triage.triage_reason: デング熱ワクチン接種プログラムによる症例減少は異常ではなく、むしろ予防対策の成功事例。IHR基準は該当せず、WPROスクリーニング基準での管理可能性は高い。ただし継続的な監視対象としての価値あり。
triage.notes: 本報は感染症危機ではなく、ワクチン接種による公衆衛生改善の報告。デング熱は東カリマンタンで流行傾向にあり（231件の累積症例、3～5年周期），長期的曝露リスクと流行性は存在するが，当該地域の保健当局は対応能力を有しており外部支援は不要と判断される。社会的・政治的関心は政府機関レベルに限定。WATCH判定は継続的な疫学監視のため。

article.articleHeadline: Alta Floresta registra 367 notificações de vírus respiratórios em 2026 " Notícia Exata - Notícias de Alta Floresta e Região!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alta Floresta Records 367 Notifications of Respiratory Viruses in 2026
article.articleSummary: As of April 30, 2026, Alta Floresta recorded 367 respiratory-virus notifications from January 1 to April 30, with data from public and private networks, hospitals, and laboratories updated to 10:00 that day. Influenza A dominated with 328 cases; H1N1 32; Influenza B 31; Covid-19 20; Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) 17; no H3N2 notifications in the period. The municipal health bulletin monitors circulating respiratory viruses to guide prevention and control actions. The Influenza A predominance signals higher circulation earlier in the year, aligning with seasonal peaks of influenza-like illness. Public guidance emphasizes keeping vaccination up to date, frequent hand hygiene, masking when symptomatic, and proper ventilation. Symptomatic individuals are advised to seek care at a health unit. The figures reflect notified cases and may be updated as technical teams revise records.

triage.headline_ja: アルタフローレスタが2026年の呼吸器ウイルス367件の通知を記録
triage.triage_reason: 季節的な呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザA主体）の通常の流行パターンであり、イベントは予期された範囲内。単一の市町村レベルでの典型的な公衆衛生監視報告である。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年のデータを報告しており、通常の季節性呼吸器ウイルス監視の定期報告と考えられる。インフルエンザA（328例）が主体で、死亡や重篤例の報告なし。予防接種推奨など標準的な公衆衛生指導が含まれている。WPRO基準で2項目該当するが、異常性・重症度なく国際的拡大リスクもないため、シグナルピックアップの基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: 過去一周新增1宗登革熱　患者曾訪越南列輸入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One new dengue fever case in the past week; the patient had traveled to Vietnam and was an imported case.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports one new dengue fever case in the past week, an imported infection in a traveler who had visited Vietnam during the incubation period. As of April 30, 2026, the city has 17 dengue cases for the year, comprising 16 imported and 1 locally acquired. For the previously announced local case, the Centre for Health Protection has conducted health assessments for about 700 people—co-workers at the same construction site and residents of the same housing estate—with none developing symptoms and no epidemiological link identified to the local case. No further details on laboratory confirmation are provided. This update underscores ongoing travel-associated dengue risk, with all 2026 Hong Kong cases so far linked to importation rather than local transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 過去一周新増1宗登革熱　患者曾訪越南列輸入
triage.triage_reason: 香港での輸入デング熱症例の報告だが、現在のところ局所的な公衆衛生影響は限定的（1事例、局所感染なし）。ただし継続的な監視が必要なため。
triage.notes: 香港での輸入症例報告。2026年通算で17例（輸入16例、局所1例）。局所患者に関しては700人の接触者スクリーニングで症状者なし。デング熱は本来流行病予防的だが、現在のところ香港での局所感染拡大の証拠はなく、IHR基準には該当しない。ベトナムでのデング熱状況については記事中に詳細がないため、ベトナムの流行状況の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Hoje tem drive-thru de vacinação contra chikungunya somente até o meio-dia em Dourados - O PROGRESSO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Today there is a drive-through vaccination against chikungunya only until noon in Dourados - The Progress
article.articleSummary: In Dourados, Brazil, a drive‑through vaccination against chikungunya was held on Friday, May 1, 2026, World Labour Day, at the city hall courtyard from 8:00 to 12:00. The initiative aims to widen access to the vaccine and strengthen disease control. The target group is adults 18–59 years old, excluding those with contraindications, after a 3–5 minute health screening. The vaccination schedule follows Instituto Butantan guidelines, developed with Valneva. Contraindications include pregnancy, lactation, immunosuppression, ongoing chemotherapy or radiotherapy, recent transplants, autoimmune diseases on immunosuppressants, BMI over 30, and other conditions affecting the immune system; vaccination may be postponed for acute fever or after recent vaccines. Officials expect about 43,000 doses to be administered, roughly 27% of the target audience, over an estimated 40 days. Health Secretary Márcio Figueiredo emphasizes vaccination as a key tool against chikungunya and public outreach is essential.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥアドスで今日、午後12時までチクングニア予防接種のドライブスルーを実施 - ザ・プログレッソ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルのドゥアドス市における予防接種キャンペーン（疾病制御の通常活動）についての報道であり、異常な感染症の流行や危機的状況の報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当せず、シグナルとして識別する必要がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のチクングニア流行に対する定期的な予防接種活動の実施通知であり、新規の疾病シグナルではない。疾病監視対象として認識はされるが、即座のシグナルトリアージは不要。

article.articleHeadline: Latest outbreaks in 19 countries as of May 1 travellers should know
article.articleSummary: As of May 1, 2026, 19 countries report outbreaks across mpox, yellow fever, measles, dengue and related pathogens. Mpox: Denmark has 4 confirmed cases (27 Apr 2026) including a locally acquired infection; Poland reports its first clade I mpox case (13 Apr 2026) linked to travel from Slovakia; Madagascar has 1,196 confirmed mpox cases and 3 deaths (Dec 2025–Apr 2026). Pakistan’s Sindh Province lists 122 suspected mpox (25 confirmed) with 9 deaths (as of 14 Apr 2026). Yellow fever: Ecuador records a fatal pediatric case (11-year-old) in Orellana Province (25 Apr 2026). cVDPV2 in Malawi: one positive environmental sample (week ending 22 Apr 2026). Measles: Bangladesh reports 19,161 suspected and 2,973 confirmed cases with 30 confirmed deaths (Mar 15–Apr 14, 2026). Dengue: Martinique 1,009 cases (to 29 Mar; DENV3); Maldives 1,908 (to 15 Apr); Tonga 24 lab-confirmed (to 20 Apr) with transmission across several islands. Bolivia: 36,007 suspected dengue and 1,168 Zika cases in 2026, plus 5 yellow fever cases (2 deaths). Zika in France (ex Indonesia): 11 travel-associated cases; linked to Bali. cVDPV1 in South Sudan: 2 cases in Upper Nile; onset Feb 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年5月1日現在、19カ国で発生中のアウトブレイク—渡航者が知るべき情報
triage.triage_reason: 複数国での多様な病原体（mpox、黄熱病、麻しん、デング熱、Zika、cVDPV）の同時多発的なアウトブレイク報告。国際的拡大リスク、重症例・死亡例を含む重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染病原体の流行性が確認され、IHR基準2項目以上、WPRO基準複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき検証：Indonesia（バリ州でZika関連）およびIndia（対象国リストに含まれるが、記事本文ではパキスタンのSindh州がmpox報告の主要地点）。対象国リスト内で実際に記事で名指しされているのはIndonesia（Bali）のみ。Bangladeshはサマリーに麻しんアウトブレイク記載があるが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Pakistan（Sindh）も対象国リストに含まれないため除外。複数国での同時多発的なアウトブレイク報告であり、国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Combate eficaz garante 10 meses sem dengue em Três Passos - Três Passos News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Effective fight guarantees 10 months dengue-free in Três Passos - Três Passos News
article.articleSummary: Três Passos' Municipal Health Secretariat, with Endemic Disease Control Agents, announced a major achievement: the municipality has completed 10 months without recorded dengue-positive cases. The sustained result reflects ongoing strategic work and community cooperation. Key actions include daily house visits to guide residents and eliminate mosquito breeding sites, installation of ovitraps at strategic points, and provision of containers for proper disposal of water-collecting materials. Additional measures comprise Residual Intradomiciliary Spraying (BRI) by appointment via WhatsApp (55) 99901-1853, public awareness during FEICAP, fogging in street manholes, installation of shade devices to prevent breeding, and intensified mosquito control in cemeteries. The program also handles public reports, treats rainwater with larvicide, conducts the LIRAa rapid index survey for Aedes aegypti, and trains the Endemias team on sporotrichosis, Chagas disease, and leptospirosis. The health secretary stressed community involvement to maintain these positive results: eliminate standing water and keep Três Passos stronger and healthier.

triage.headline_ja: 効果的な対策が保証する10ヶ月のデング熱ゼロ達成　トレスパソス市
triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング熱撲滅の成功事例を報告しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的な拡大リスクはない。むしろ予防対策の有効性を示す肯定的なニュースであり、ピックアップの基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の患者ゼロ達成という良好な疾病制御状況を報告しており、新規発生や危機的状況ではない。記事内でスポロトリコーシス、シャーガス病、レプトスピラ症の訓練に言及されているが、これらは具体的な発生事例ではなく教育・準備の一環である。したがってシグナルとしてのピックアップ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Учения по предотвращению распространения холеры прошли в Горно-Алтайске
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drills to prevent the spread of cholera were held in Gorno-Altaysk.
article.articleSummary: Cholera prevention drills were conducted in Gorno-Altaysk, Russia, following a scenario on a Delhi–Gorno-Altaysk flight in which a passenger displayed cholera-like symptoms one hour before landing. Upon arrival, airport medical staff, the sanitary-quarantine checkpoint of Rospotrebnadzor, and border-service personnel promptly responded. The passenger was evacuated after an initial assessment suggested a dangerous infection, and comprehensive anti-epidemic measures were implemented. Airport officials, including First Deputy Director Vladimir Kulikov, said these exercises are held annually before the tourist season to test interagency readiness. Separately in Gorno-Altaysk, doctors performed a complex operation on a patient previously deemed inoperable. The report also notes that HIV is detected more often in rural areas of the Republic of Altai.

triage.headline_ja: ゴルノ-アルタイスクでコレラの拡大防止訓練が実施された
triage.triage_reason: これは実際のコレラ発症事例ではなく、定期的に実施される公衆衛生訓練（年1回の観光シーズン前の演習）の報告である。実際の感染症アウトブレイク、死亡、複数の症例、国際的な拡散リスクはない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアのゴルノ-アルタイスクで実施されたコレラ対策訓練について述べている。訓練シナリオではデリーからゴルノ-アルタイスク行の便が想定されているため、Indiaは verified_locations に含めた。ただし、これは訓練であり実際のアウトブレイクではないため、DISMISS判定となる。HIV言及は背景情報であり、主要なシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: 46 hospitalized after suspected 'banh mi' food poisoning in Vietnam's Quang Tri
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-01, 46 people in Quang Tri Province, Vietnam, were hospitalized with suspected food poisoning linked to banh mi from a single bakery in Tan Lap Commune. Huong Hoa Regional General Hospital in Khe Sanh Commune admitted patients from 6:30 am on Apr 29 to midnight on May 1. Affected individuals, ages 4–46, mainly students aged 11–15 from Huong Loc Semi-Boarding School for Ethnic Minorities, reported high fever, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal cramps, fatigue, and dehydration. Treatments included intravenous fluids, oral rehydration therapy, and antibiotics; no severe cases yet. Local authorities have identified those who ate from the bakery and referred symptomatic individuals for care. Food samples have been collected for testing; investigators are probing the cause and reporting to higher authorities. Laboratory confirmation is pending.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのクアンチ省でバインミー食中毒の疑いで46人が入院
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒の集団発生であり、異常性と重症度の基準は満たすが、国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクは低い。情報が完全でないため、検査結果の確定と拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 食中毒の原因物質は確定していない。病原体が特定されるまで、感染症的な脅威の全容は判明していない。当該学校での拡大がないこと、感染者の症状が中程度であることから、現時点では国際的懸念は低い。検査結果の確定とその後の拡大の有無が重要。

article.articleHeadline: First Whitmore's disease case of 2026 recorded in Gia Lai
article.articleSummary: First melioidosis (Whitmore's disease) case of 2026 confirmed in Gia Lai: a 39-year-old woman Ksor H'P from Mook Trang village, Ia Dom commune, near the border. She developed fever and body pains on April 16, progressing to respiratory failure and septic shock. Initially misdiagnosed as dengue; transferred to Gia Lai Provincial General Hospital. Investigations linked frequent soil and muddy-water exposure from farming and river bathing as risk factors. She remains on mechanical ventilation in the ICU. No similar cases reported in her village or Ia Dom commune; local stations are monitoring contacts and exposures. Preventive guidance emphasizes protective gear during farming, avoiding contaminated water, proper wound care, and prompt medical attention for fever, cough, pneumonia, or abscesses. Melioidosis is caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei and is endemic in tropical Vietnam; rapid progression can cause septic shock, underscoring need for early diagnosis. Separately, a melioidosis case was reported in Dak Lak.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ザライ州で初めてのホイットモア病（メリオイドーシス）患者を報告
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスは熱帯地域で土壌を介する新興感染症であり、患者が急速に敗血性ショックに進行（機械換気必要）し、初期診断の困難性（デング熱と誤診）が示されている。また記事は公衆衛生当局の関与と予防措置の強調を含み、IHR基準（異常性・重症度）とWPRO基準（管理可能性・重症度）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはベトナム国内（ザライ州およびダクラク省）における複数のメリオイドーシス症例を報告している。患者は機械換気が必要な重症であり、初期診断困難性（デング熱との誤診）が示されている。土壌・汚染水への曝露が確認されており、ベトナムにおけるメリオイドーシスの地域流行性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Suspek Campak, Balita 5 Bulan di Tasikmalaya Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected measles, 5-month-old infant dies in Tasikmalaya.
article.articleSummary: Suspected measles and a 5‑month‑old infant died in Tasikmalaya, West Java. The patient from Cihideung district died after two days in the ICU at RSUD Dr Soekardjo, following seizures and pneumonia with strong suspicion of measles. Laboratory samples were sent to Labkesda Jawa Barat for confirmation; results pending. In 2026, Tasikmalaya reported 120 suspected measles cases from January to April, with 38 confirmed by Labkesda Jawa Barat. Immunization progress trails target: 95% for 2026, with 23% achieved in Q1. Authorities launched Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) across 22 puskesmas to reach about 6,000 children and accelerate immunization for 9-month to grade 1 age range. Immunization at puskesmas is free; parental awareness urged to improve coverage.

triage.headline_ja: 疑い麻疹、タシクマラヤで5ヶ月の乳児が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア西ジャワ州タシクマラヤで麻疹疑い症例の死亡が報告された。2026年1月～4月に120例の疑い症例があり38例が確定診断されており、予防接種率が目標（95%）に対して23%に留まっている。重症度（乳幼児死亡）・異常性（集団発生）が認められ、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当するシグナルである。
triage.notes: タシクマラヤはインドネシア西ジャワ州に位置し、記事サマリーから実際の発生地はインドネシアで確認。2026年1月～4月で120例の疑い症例、38例の確定例が報告されており、予防接種率の低さ（23%/目標95%）が懸念。政府は緊急予防接種プログラム（ORI）を展開中で、当局の対応が既に開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue fever cases near 45,000 as rainy season raises outbreak risk
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Vietnam has reached 44,965 cases nationwide with 5 deaths since December 14, 2025, as the rainy season raises outbreak risk. In April, 6,408 new infections and one fatality were recorded, with four-month infections 1.8 times higher than the same period in 2025 and deaths up by two. Health authorities warn that cases may continue to rise during peak rainy months due to hot, humid weather and household water storage practices that foster mosquito breeding. The Health Ministry also reports over 86,000 dengue cases this year with 17 deaths, underscoring sustained transmission. The sector is coordinating with local governments to monitor outbreaks, respond to hotspots, and strengthen public awareness campaigns. Preventive actions—eliminating breeding sites, covering water containers, and protecting against bites—should be performed regularly; weekly measures can meaningfully reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の症例が45,000件近くに達する、雨季は流行リスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでデング熱の大規模な流行が継続中で、症例数が44,965件、死亡5件に達しており、雨季による更なる拡大リスクが指摘されている。IHR基準で「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」および「異常/予想外な事象」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準で「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」が認められる。
triage.notes: デング熱のベトナムでの大規模流行。2025年12月14日以降44,965症例、死亡5名。4月単月で6,408新規感染、死亡1名。同年同期比で感染1.8倍、死亡2倍。雨季（5-9月）のピーク期に更なる増加が懸念される。保健省は予防対策強化と住民啓発キャンペーンを実施中。

article.articleHeadline: ഇടവേളയ്ക്ക് ശേഷം സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് വീണ്ടും മസ്തിഷ്കജ്വരം ബാധിച്ച് മരണം, ആലപ്പുഴ സ്വദേശി ചികിത്സയിലിരിക്കെ മരിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis claims another life in the state after a lull; an Alappuzha resident dies while undergoing treatment.
article.articleSummary: Meningitis, a severe brain infection also called encephalitis, has claimed another life in Kerala after a lull. A 26-year-old Alappuzha resident, Arya, died this morning while undergoing treatment at Thiruvananthapuram Medical College. The article notes that meningitis is a serious infection affecting brain tissue, which can be caused by bacteria, viruses, or amoebae, and may occur with immune system impairment. No additional case counts, outbreak details, or laboratory confirmation are provided. The report highlights the location specifics: patient from Alappuzha district and treatment at Thiruvananthapuram Medical College hospital, illustrating ongoing risk of central nervous system infections in the state. The piece does not identify the exact infection source or whether the case involved travel or import/export. Published date: 1 May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 脳炎による死亡がケーララ州で再び発生。アラッピュザの住民が治療中に死亡

triage.notes: 患者は26歳のアラッピュザ地区住民。治療はティルヴァナンタプラム医科大学で実施。疾患名は「Unknown Encephalitis」であるが、サマリーでは原虫性髄膜脳炎の可能性を示唆。具体的な病原体確認なし。ケーララ州での一時的な沈静後の再発生との記述あり、既知のリスク地域での継続的な事例発生を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Asunafo North MP commissions borehole to fight water-borne diseases - Adomonline.com
article.articleSummary: Kwame Asantekrom, in the Asunafo North Municipality of the Ahafo Region, Ghana, received a new borehole water system commissioned by MP Haruna Mohammed to address years of water scarcity and related health risks. The project, born from observations during the 2024 campaign, aims to curb water-borne diseases, notably typhoid, linked to unsafe drinking water used by farmers. The MP emphasized clean, potable water as a basic necessity and pledged to extend the initiative to all communities in the constituency. Residents including Yaa Serwaa, Afia Amponsaa, and Prince Nkum expressed gratitude, noting that unsafe water had caused frequent illnesses. The borehole is expected to improve sanitation, public health, and ease daily access to clean water, aligning with broader local health-improvement goals.

article.articleHeadline: Maharashtra bird flu: 150-200 chickens dead, 1.4 lakh to be culled in Nandurbar - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: As of 1 May 2026, avian influenza (bird flu) has been confirmed in Maharashtra's Nandurbar district after a spike in Navapur poultry deaths. Approximately 150–200 chickens died at a farm on 13–14 April; samples were tested and confirmed by a laboratory in Bhopal. A one-kilometre containment zone has been declared around the affected farm, and culling of about 1.4 lakh chickens from six farms is underway as a preventive measure. This marks the third reported bird-flu case in Navapur, with ongoing disruptions and financial losses to the local poultry sector. No human infections have been reported; residents are advised to avoid contact with birds and to ensure poultry products are thoroughly cooked. Earlier in April, Nagpur reported culling of over 1,000 chickens and destruction of about 14,000 eggs at a government hatchery, with restrictions and a nine-kilometre surveillance zone.

triage.triage_reason: インドにおける鳥インフルエンザの確定例で、複数地域での発生、大規模な防疫措置（1.4万羽の殺処分）、農業・食料安全保障への影響があり、異常性・管理可能性の観点からWPRO基準3項目以上を満たす。
