article.articleHeadline: Squirrel Terror at Mohanlal Sukhadia University: 'Sneaky' Attacker Bites 18, Students Too Scared To Walk on Campus in Udaipur (Watch Video) | 📰 LatestLY
article.articleSummary: Rogue squirrel bites more than 18 people at Mohanlal Sukhadia University in Udaipur, India, over the past month, with most incidents around the Arts College near the Psychology and Women's Studies departments. On April 22, the animal allegedly targeted two research scholars, raising campus fear. Attempts by the Animal Aid team to capture the squirrel have failed; authorities plan to involve wildlife experts to trap and relocate the animal to a safer habitat. The squirrel’s aggressive behavior—hiding behind curtains and suddenly lunging at passersby—has disrupted classes as students skip sessions. Experts suggest extreme heat and possible food scarcity may drive the aggression. Those injured have received tetanus shots as a precaution, and officials say renewed efforts are underway to bring the situation under control soon.

article.articleHeadline: Delhi to declare leprosy a notifiable disease to boost surveillance
article.articleSummary: Delhi will declare leprosy as a notifiable disease under the Delhi Epidemic Diseases Act, requiring all government and private healthcare providers to report every new case to the District Leprosy Officer. The move, supported by Health Minister Dr. Pankaj Kumar Singh, aims to improve surveillance, enable early diagnosis, and ensure prompt MDT treatment—free in government facilities. Delhi joins Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and West Bengal in mandating notification. Although India achieved national elimination of leprosy as a public health problem in 2005, it accounts for 59% of global annual new cases. A pan-India study found 44.1% of patients are managed by private facilities and go unreported to NLEP, sustaining transmission. Mandatory notification is expected to aid early detection, contact tracing, PEP, reduce stigma, and improve treatment compliance, supporting India’s goal of interruption of transmission by 2030. The proposal follows GNCTD Act 1991; guidelines will be issued to health facilities.

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa proíbe consumo de lote de sardinha por presença de Salmonella
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa bans consumption of a batch of sardines due to the presence of Salmonella.
article.articleSummary: On Apr 29, 2026, Brazil’s Anvisa ordered the recall of a batch of frozen sardine product due to Salmonella spp. contamination. The affected item is batch 1309902244 of 'Frozen Sardine Laje (gutted and eviscerated)' produced by JMS Indústria e Comércio de Pescados in Penha. Anvisa suspended sale, distribution, and use after laboratory results from the company’s voluntary recall showed unsatisfactory microbiological quality, unsafe for human consumption. The company reported immediate action and notification to customers and authorities. Salmonella infection can cause vomiting, abdominal pain, fever, and diarrhea, and may rarely lead to severe illness. Under RDC 655/2022, confirmed health risks require mandatory removal; voluntary recall is preventive. Consumers who bought the batch should avoid consumption and contact the packaging’s SAC. JMS stated investigations found no contamination in the production environment, suggesting an external environmental source.

article.articleHeadline: Brasil avança no mercado de frango e reforça cuidados contra influenza aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil advances in the poultry market and reinforces measures against avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s poultry sector advanced in 2025, expanding markets while overcoming the first high-pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) case in a commercial unit on May 15, 2025. A rapid, coordinated response restored disease-free status within 34 days, validated by the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH). Under ABPA leadership, the industry stressed discipline, planning, and technical rigor to sustain global credibility amid a volatile international market. Production remained strong and multi-protein, supporting domestic supply and export growth to China, Vietnam, the European Union, Chile, and other strategic destinations; products included poultry meat, giblets, pork, and by-products. Biosafety and surveillance were reinforced after the outbreak, with collaboration among the Ministry of Agriculture, veterinary services, and industry. Federal Inspection Service (SIF) oversight and ongoing evaluations by more than 150 importing countries underpin Brazil’s quality reputation and market opportunities, as reported in the ABPA 2026 Annual Report.

article.articleHeadline: Raiva humana: adolescente de 17 anos morre após mordida de sagui | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human Rabies: 17-Year-Old Dies After Being Bitten by a Squirrel Monkey | A TARDE
article.articleSummary: Rabies diagnosed in a 17-year-old male in Piauí, Brazil, who died after a bite from a squirrel monkey (sagui) in rural Oeiras. Marlon Kaik da Silva died on April 17 in Teresina after treatment at the Instituto de Doenças Tropicais Natan Portella. Diagnosis confirmed by Sesapi based on laboratory tests at Instituto Pasteur. Symptoms appeared about 40 days after the bite and included fever, vomiting, and disorientation. Sesapi launched epidemiological surveillance with the patient’s municipality to prevent further cases. Ministry guidance for animal attacks urges immediate wound washing with soap and water, urgent medical care, and not capturing the animal; vaccination of dogs and cats remains essential for prevention. The state’s last rabies case occurred in 2024 in Piripiri.

article.articleHeadline: Painel amplia monitoramento do tratamento preventivo da tuberculose no Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panel expands monitoring of tuberculosis preventive therapy in Amazonas.
article.articleSummary: On May 1, 2026, the Amazonas Foundation for Health Surveillance (FVS-RCP) released the Tuberculosis Preventive Therapy (TPT) Dashboard on its official site, organizing data on people undergoing preventive treatment for latent tuberculosis infection (LTBI) in Amazonas, Brazil. The panel tracks program reach, user profiles, and the evolution of treatment availability, aiding surveillance and health planning. Nearly 11,000 individuals have benefited to date. The dashboard emphasizes prioritizing high-risk groups—contacts of TB cases, people living with HIV, and patients on immunosuppressive therapies—and highlights advances such as expanded TPT in primary health care, shorter therapeutic regimens, and broader prescribing authority for nurses and pharmacists. Developed through collaboration among municipal health secretariats, research and teaching institutions, reference services, and the Dr. Heitor Vieira Dourado Tropical Medicine Foundation, the tool enhances transparency and supports decisions to strengthen the TB response in the Amazon region.

article.articleHeadline: Measles case counts mount in Utah, Arizona, while Bangladesh, Guatemala battle deadly outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks dominate the Americas and parts of Asia with US activity and international transmission. Utah added 18 cases to reach 428, Arizona +2 for 93, while South Carolina’s outbreak is declared over. The US year-to-date total is 1,814 cases (up from 1,792), with 1)803 cases across 37 states and New York City and 11 in international visitors; 24 new outbreaks this year, and 93% of cases outbreak-associated (415 from 2026 outbreaks and 1,273 from 2025 outbreaks). Among 1,814 patients, 6% were hospitalized; 92% were unvaccinated or of unknown status, 4% had one dose; 51% are aged 5–19, 21% under 5. Last year saw 2,288 cases and three deaths; no deaths reported so far in 2026. Measles remains eliminated in 2000 but is resurging. Bangladesh reports nearly 35,000 suspected cases since mid-March with 227 deaths, notably in Kurukpata, Chittagong Hill Tracts near Myanmar amid rural vaccine hesitancy. Guatemala’s outbreak began December 2025, reaching 5,297 cases and four deaths as of late last week, with infant fatalities; cases down 94% in the past month from a peak 906 weekly to 51.

article.articleHeadline: Delhi Govt Moves To Make Leprosy Notifiable Disease, All Cases To Be Reported For Early Treatment
article.articleSummary: Delhi government proposes making leprosy a notifiable disease with mandatory reporting of all cases to enable early treatment. Although India achieved leprosy elimination as a public health problem in 2005 (prevalence <1 per 10,000), it still accounts for about 59% of global annual new leprosy cases. A pan-India study found 44.1% of patients are managed by private facilities and go unreported to the National Leprosy Eradication Programme (NLEP), sustaining hidden transmission. Variability in treatment protocols raises the risk of drug resistance. WHO’s Independent Evaluation of NLEP recommends including leprosy in the list of diseases mandatory for notification, underscoring the need for comprehensive reporting to curb transmission and enable timely intervention across India, including Delhi. The move focuses on improved case detection, standardization of treatment, and faster access to care.

article.articleHeadline: Avances en el diagnóstico: nace una prueba de tuberculosis que no necesita flema - La Opinión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Advances in diagnosis: a tuberculosis test that does not require sputum has emerged
article.articleSummary: MiniDock MTB, a new molecular TB test, detects tuberculosis using accessible samples such as tongue swabs, reducing diagnostic time and cost and enabling near‑point‑of‑care use. TB remains the world’s deadliest infectious disease, killing over one million people each year. In a study of nearly 1,400 patients across Africa and Asia, MiniDock met World Health Organization accuracy standards, offering faster, more reliable results than sputum‑based methods. From Chinese company Pluslif, the device has been highlighted by Ugandan microbiologist Alfred Andama of Makerere University College of Health Sciences. Designed for near‑POC operation, MiniDock MTB differs from sputum smear microscopy, cultures, and radiography in speed and sample type, though it has limitations in early detection and cannot distinguish drug‑resistant strains. Experts view it as a step toward removing microscopes from TB diagnosis and expanding access in vulnerable communities.

triage.headline_ja: 診断における進歩：痰を必要としない結核検査が登場
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新しい結核診断技術（MiniDock MTB）の紹介・医学的進展についての報道であり、能動的な感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルではない。IHR基準および WPRO スクリーニング基準への該当がない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核診断技術の開発・臨床試験成功についての医学ニュースであり、新規発生症例やアウトブレイク、公衆衛生の危機的状況ではない。中国企業による技術開発がウガンダの研究者により紹介されているが、イベント発生としてのシグナルではなく、技術進展の報道である。

article.articleHeadline: Fenasoja terá fóruns sobre suinocultura, brucelose e tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fenasoja will host forums on swine farming, brucellosis, and tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: During Fenasoja, May 1–10 in Santa Rosa, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, a dedicated Animal Health Day will host two forums on May 6: the 2nd State Forum on Swine Health at 10:00 and the 1st State Forum on Brucellosis and Bovine Tuberculosis at 14:00. Organized by the DDA/Seapi and Fundesa, the Swine Health forum will focus on biosecurity in pig farming, disease prevention strategies, sanitary risk reduction, herd protection, and strengthened collaboration between industry and the Official Veterinary Service. The Brucellosis and Bovine Tuberculosis forum will cover prevention and control, with lectures from the dairy industry, farmers, Fundesa, and the Official State Veterinary Service. Santa Rosa is in a top milk-producing region, aiming to mobilize and raise awareness across the production chain.

triage.headline_ja: Fenasoja（ブラジル大豆フォーラム）が養豚、ブルセラ症、牛結核に関するフォーラムを開催
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルの農業展示会（Fenasoja）における教育的フォーラムの開催案内であり、実際の疾病多発や緊急事態を報告するものではない。疾病の発生状況に関する情報がなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性が認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブルセラ症と牛結核に関する農業フォーラムの開催案内であり、実際の疾病発生や流行の報告ではない。予防・啓発活動の告知に過ぎず、シグナル検知の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Após três meses de queda, MS fecha abril com alta nos casos de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After three months of decline, the Ministry of Health ends April with a rise in dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil shows a mixed 2026 trend: the first quarter had a 76% drop in probable dengue cases versus 2025, but April 2026 reported 1.5% more cases than April 2025. Year-to-date total is 4,818 probable dengue cases, with transmission by Aedes aegypti; in 2025, April had 8,794 cases. The state is also battling a chikungunya outbreak with over 9,000 confirmed cases and 14 deaths. Week-by-week, dengue rose in early April 2026; the second week was 5.6% higher than the previous year, and by week 16 (late April) cases were 8.8% above 2025. Eighteen municipalities have high dengue incidence, led by Seven Quedas, Douradina, Angélica, Corumbá, and Batayporã (>1,000 cases per 100,000). Overall incidence is 173.3/100,000; Campo Grande has 37 probable cases (4.1/100,000) and Corguinho reports none. Prevention emphasizes source reduction and water/garbage management.

triage.headline_ja: 3ヶ月の低下後、MS（マットグロッソドゥスール州）が4月にデング熱患者数の増加で締めくくる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マットグロッソドゥスール州でデング熱とチクングニヤの同時流行が発生。デング熱は前月比で増加傾向に転じ、チクングニヤは9,000件以上の確定症例と14人の死亡を記録。これは複合的なアルボウイルス脅威を示唆し、IHR基準および WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのマットグロッソドゥスール州（MS）を主要な発生地として明確に特定している。デング熱とチクングニヤの2つのアルボウイルス感染症が同時に流行していることが重要。デング熱は4月の感染数が前年同月比で増加に転じ、チクングニヤは14名の死亡者を含む9,000件以上の確定症例が報告されており、重症度が高い。18の自治体で高い罹患率が観察されており、複数地域での持続的な伝播が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Envu India Supports National Conclave Uniting India's Public Health Leadership to Advance Urban Vector-Borne Disease Control
article.articleSummary: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, 28 April 2026: A national technical conclave on urban pest management and vector control addressed dengue, malaria and chikungunya in India's expanding cities. Organized by ISMOCD with Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation and supported by Envu India, the event gathered public health leaders, AFMC, academia and experts. Sessions covered urban epidemiology, ovitrap-based AI surveillance, WHO-aligned Integrated Vector Management, Urban Malaria Scheme, National Urban Health Mission, mass-gathering preparedness, and innovations in insecticides. Envu shared insights from Malaysia’s iDEM program. CSE notes Delhi fogging uses 95% diesel and 5% insecticide (about 450,000 L per season). WHO guidance favors larval control to sustain impact; Envu promotes water-based, WHO Pre-Qualified formulations with safer larvicides. India aims to eliminate malaria, lymphatic filariasis and kala-azar by 2030, with malaria deaths down from about 800,000 at independence to 83 in 2023, kala-azar from 9,241 in 2014 to 449 in 2024, and over 100 districts having eliminated LF.

triage.headline_ja: インドの公衆衛生指導者を結集する国家協議会がアーメダバードで開催、都市蚊媒介感染症対策を推進
triage.triage_reason: 複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング、マラリア、チクングニア）がインドで取り上げられているが、本記事は技術協議会・政策強化の報告であり、新規発生や危機的状況ではなく、むしろ対策強化の成果報告である。情報不足が多く経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は新規アウトブレイクではなく、国家技術協議会における蚊媒介感染症対策の推進・政策共有に関する報告。マラリア死亡数の大幅減少（2023年83例）、カラアザール症例の減少など、対策の成功が記載されている。マレーシアの技術共有も含まれるが、インド国内での対策強化が主題。スクリーニング基準2項目該当だが、これは既知の風土病への継続的対策であり、新規シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatite A: Juiz de Fora tem 70% dos casos de MG e morte suspeita | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis A: Juiz de Fora accounts for 70% of the cases in Minas Gerais and a suspected death | G1
article.articleSummary: Juiz de Fora, Minas Gerais, Brazil reports 729 confirmed Hepatitis A cases, with 114 new records in the last eight days, and a death under investigation: a 60-year-old woman hospitalized at Therezinha de Jesus. Juiz de Fora accounts for 70% of Minas Gerais’ 2026 cases. Year’s total already exceeds the decade’s cases, with a 1,925% rise from 2025 (36 cases). Cases span all city regions, concentrated in the area and the south. Vaccination has been expanded to include strategic groups and contacts of cases, in addition to the pediatric calendar: children 15 months–less than 5; pregnant; liver disease patients; immunosuppressed; PrEP users; unvaccinated 11–39 year-olds living with cases; and sexual partners of cases of any age. Transmission is fecal-oral; symptoms appear 15–50 days after exposure and include jaundice, dark urine, pale stools, fatigue, abdominal pain, and fever. Prevention includes water disinfection, case testing, sanitary inspections, and hygiene guidance.

triage.headline_ja: Hepatitis A: Juiz de Fora accounts for 70% of the cases in Minas Gerais and a suspected death | G1
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外（2025年比1,925%の上昇）」「公衆衛生への影響（729確定例、死亡例）」が該当（2つ以上）。WPRO基準でも「重症度（入院・死亡）」「異常性」「流行性（フェーカル・オーラル、全地域への拡大）」が複数該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列。しかし疾患の性質（急速な流行、高い増加率、死亡例、全地域への拡大、ワクチン接種の拡大対応）から見て、IHR基準とWPRO基準の複数項目に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: Gurgaon launches fever survey amid fears of early dengue, malaria rise | Gurgaon News
article.articleSummary: Gurgaon launches a city-wide fever survey from May 1–15 each month through October to preempt dengue and malaria. May survey already underway with 102 teams inspecting areas with past cases and identifying water-holding containers to curb breeding. Excess pre-monsoon rainfall (April 23.8 mm vs 7.7 mm; 209% above normal) and rising humidity heighten mosquito breeding; larval sites will be geo-tagged to build a regular-monsoon database and compare hotspots with prior years, targeting dengue-prone localities. There is no fever clustering yet; a doctor-call centre will monitor patients daily if positive. Haryana dengue cases have fluctuated (2021: 11,835; 2022: 8,996; 2023: 8,081; 2025: 2,033) while malaria has been less frequent (2021: 54; 2022: 50; 2023: 85). Gurgaon dengue counts: 2022 440; 2023 276 (one death); 2024 186; 2025 64. Malaria outbreaks are relatively uncommon; seek care for persistent fever and regularly empty stagnant water sources.

triage.headline_ja: ジャイプル市がデング熱・マラリア増加への懸念の中で発熱調査を開始
triage.triage_reason: インドで季節性のデング熱・マラリア対策として発熱調査が開始されており、過度な降雨によるベクター媒介の懸念がある。ただし現時点で発熱クラスタリングは報告されておらず、情報が予防的措置段階に留まっている。
triage.notes: 記事はグルガオン市（ハリヤナ州、インド）における予防的な公衆衛生対策を報じている。過去の事例に基づいて実施される月次発熱調査であり、現時点では活動的な病例クラスターは確認されていない。過剰な降雨と湿度がベクター繁殖を助長するため、継続的な監視が必要。引き続き感染状況の推移を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de caxumba aumentam quase 50% no Rio e autoridades reforçam importância da vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mumps cases rise by nearly 50% in Rio de Janeiro, and authorities reiterate the importance of vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro state records a 46.8% rise in mumps in Q1 2026, with 395 cases vs 210 in Q1 2025. Children under nine account for over half (37% aged 5–9; 26% aged 1–4). No outbreak or deaths have been reported. Health authorities attribute the increase to waning vaccination coverage and stress that vaccination remains the primary prevention. The measles-mumps-rubella (triple viral) vaccine is used; first dose at 12 months and second dose (tetraviral) at 15 months. State coverage is 85.62% for the first dose and 70.03% for the second; priority municipalities include Rio de Janeiro, Duque de Caxias, Nova Iguaçu, São Gonçalo and Belford Roxo, with a 95% target. Mumps causes swollen salivary glands; incubation is 12–25 days; possible complications include meningitis, sensorineural deafness, encephalitis, pancreatitis. Influenza vaccination resumes in Rio at three Super Centers (Botafogo, Shopping Nova América, ParkShopping) and later at all Family Clinics and Municipal Health Centers.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロの流行性耳下腺炎（おたふく風邪）患者が約50%増加、当局がワクチン接種の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 流行性耳下腺炎の50%近い増加は予想外だが、死亡例や集団発生は報告されておらず、現在のところIHR基準2つ以上には該当しない。ただし予防接種カバレッジの低下と小児への濃厚な影響が見られるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はポルトガル語で、複数の疾患が記載されているが、主題は流行性耳下腺炎（mumps）の増加である。死亡例や確認された集団発生がないため深刻度は中程度だが、ワクチン接種カバレッジの低下が背景にあり、流行性耳下腺炎は人-人感染が可能で集団発生リスクがある。インフルエンザワクチンの再開も並行して進められている。今後の患者数動向とワクチン接種キャンペーンの効果を注視する必要がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 44 peacock deaths in Karnataka's Tumakuru linked to H5N1 avian influenza | Bengaluru News
article.articleSummary: As of May 1, 2026, 44 peacocks died in Tumakuru district, Karnataka, between April 16–24 in Bommanahalli and Machenahalli villages, due to H5N1 avian influenza confirmed by lab tests on carcasses. Initial heat-stress theories were replaced by disease containment after confirmation. A 33-village 10-km radius high-alert zone was established with disinfectant spraying and enhanced surveillance. A multi-department rapid response team—veterinarians, revenue officials, gram panchayat members, and forest personnel—oversees field monitoring and containment, including monitoring poultry movements and sampling birds. Authorities suspect a virus spillover from nearby poultry farms, prompting sensitisation of poultry owners and traders and ongoing sample collection. No fresh peacock deaths have been reported since April 23, with continuous monitoring of affected and surrounding areas to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: カルナータカ州トゥムクールの孔雀44羽の死亡がH5N1鳥インフルエンザに関連していることが判明
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの確認症例であり、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。動物での感染確認は公衆衛生上の懸念材料であり、人での感染リスク監視が必要。
triage.notes: H5N1確認は家禽でも野生動物でも重大なシグナル。2026年時点での記事であり、スピルオーバーリスク評価と継続監視が重要。現時点で人への感染報告なし。州レベルでの迅速対応チーム配置と監視体制が確立されている。

article.articleHeadline: Asanko Gold partners with health authorities to tackle rising malaria cases in Amansie West
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Ghana’s Amansie West District is rising for a second year, with under‑five cases increasing from 8,000 in 2024 to 10,000 in 2025 and district outpatient malaria cases climbing from over 36,000 to more than 38,000 in the same period. Health officials attribute the surge to illegal small‑scale mining (galamsey), whose pits create mosquito breeding grounds across communities. On World Malaria Day, authorities urged complete anti‑malaria treatment courses and consistent use of long‑lasting insecticide‑treated nets, stressing that severe malaria risk justifies intensified prevention. Asanko Gold Ghana Limited organized free malaria testing and general health screenings in Manso Abore, distributed over 2,000 insecticide‑treated nets to senior high school students, and outlined plans to construct CHPS compounds at Tetrem and Krofrom to improve access. The event highlighted ongoing prevention, community education, and local investments to curb transmission under the theme Driven to End Malaria: Now We Can. Now We Must.

triage.headline_ja: アサンコゴールドが保健当局と協力し、アマンシエウェスト地区のマラリア急増に対処
triage.triage_reason: ガーナのアマンシエウェスト地区でマラリア症例が増加しており、スクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、重症度、長期曝露）が複数該当するが、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクに関する情報が不足しており、現段階では要経過観察とする。
triage.notes: IHR基準2つ以上該当し、スクリーニング基準4つ全て該当。連続2年のマラリア症例増加（特に5歳未満児）、違法採掘による蚊の繁殖地増加、重症マラリアリスク言及など懸念材料が多い。ただし国際的拡大の証拠は記事に明記されていない。アフリカ地域のマラリア流行は構造的な課題であり、広域的な監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: اليمن يسجل آلاف الإصابات بالكوليرا و3 حالات وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yemen records thousands of cholera cases and 3 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreaks in Yemen persisted in early 2026. From Jan 1 to Mar 29, Yemen registered 3,177 suspected cholera cases and 3 deaths, per WHO. Yemen ranked fifth globally for cholera in the first three months, behind the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan, Mozambique and South Sudan, and had the second-highest cholera infections and deaths in WHO’s Eastern Mediterranean Region, with 24,009 cases and 9 deaths year-to-date. In March alone, Yemen saw 969 new cases and 2 deaths, ranking fourth worldwide for monthly infections. Globally, 58,740 cholera and acute watery diarrhea cases and 732 deaths were reported in 22 countries across four WHO regions in Q1 2026. UNICEF, in late March, announced a Japan-funded 6 million USD project to boost health and nutrition services for more than 600,000 Yemenis affected by cholera and measles, across 9 governorates, supporting 150 primary care facilities, vaccines, medicines, and training 130 health workers, reaching about 670,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: イエメンがコレラの数千人の感染者と3人の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。複数国での発生と国際支援実施により、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、イエメンを主題とするコレラ・麻疹のアウトブレイク報告だが、評価対象国リストではイエメンが含まれていない。検証位置としてはDRCのみ対象国に該当。発生地域フィールドにはJapan、Afghanistan、Mozambique、Sudan、Yemenが列挙されているが、これらのうち対象国はDRCのみ。世界的な規模での複数国コレラ流行（22カ国、4WHO地域）は重大な公衆衛生イベントであり、国際的な支援継続中（UNICEF日本資金6百万USD）。

article.articleHeadline: Boletim das Arboviroses: Vitória da Conquista permanece sem casos confirmados para dengue, zika e chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arboviruses Bulletin: Vitória da Conquista remains without confirmed cases of Dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Vitória da Conquista Arboviruses Bulletin for the 16th Epidemiological Week (April 19–25) reports 47 suspected dengue notifications, 1 suspected chikungunya, and no confirmed or hospitalized arbovirus cases. Of the 47 dengue notifications, 46 are probable infections under investigation, with one case discarded; one chikungunya case is also under investigation. Dengue probable cases are spread across 29 neighborhoods, led by Espírito Santo (6), Bateias (4), and Jatobá (3). The Municipal Health Secretariat maintains Aedes aegypti control with weekly monitoring and guidance to eliminate standing water, proper waste disposal, sealed water tanks, cleaned gutters, and use of repellents. Health units urge individuals with fever, headaches, body pains, red rash, and nausea to seek care. Vaccination is available citywide for children and adolescents aged 10–14; older adults are not eligible per Anvisa. Endemias Centre contact: (77) 3429-7421.

triage.headline_ja: アルボウイルス速報：ビトーリア・ダ・コンキスタはデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニアの確認患者がゼロのままである
triage.triage_reason: 確認患者がなく、調査中の疑い患者のみの報告。地域の通常の感染症監視活動であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本報告は地域の定期的なアルボウイルス監視速報であり、ブラジル（ビトーリア・ダ・コンキスタ市）では確認患者はゼロ。疑い患者は調査中だが、入院者や死亡はなく、重症度は低い。デング・チクングニアは地域で周年性だが、このイベントは異常ではなく通常の監視活動である。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi moves to make leprosy a notifiable disease | Delhi News
article.articleSummary: Delhi will make leprosy a notifiable disease under the Delhi Epidemic Diseases Act, joining Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Karnataka and Bengal. The proposal requires all government and private health facilities to report every new leprosy case to the district leprosy officer for timely intervention. The capital has already notified diseases to the Act such as rabies, cholera, malaria, Covid and tuberculosis; inclusion of leprosy will bolster surveillance, enable early diagnosis, targeted interventions, and prompt, free multi-drug therapy in government facilities. Although India eliminated leprosy as a public health threat in 2005, it accounts for about 59% of global new cases, with over 44% of patients treated in private facilities and unreported to NLEP. WHO supports mandatory notification. Health Minister Pankaj Singh says the move will help find hidden cases, curb transmission, reduce disability and support 2030 eradication goals.

triage.headline_ja: デリーがハンセン病を届出対象疾病に指定へ
triage.triage_reason: インドで複数の感染症（ハンセン病を含む6疾患）が報告されており、ハンセン病は全世界の新規患者の約59%をインドが占める。公衆衛生影響は深刻でありWHOも支持する政策である。
triage.notes: 記事はデリーおよび複数のインド州（タミルナド、マハラシュトラ、カルナタカ、西ベンガル）でハンセン病を含む6疾患の届出制度について報告。インドは全世界のハンセン病新規患者の約59%を占め、民間施設での未報告例が多いことが課題とされている。WPROスクリーニング基準で4項目該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: A raiva ainda existe? Veja os riscos para seu pet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is rabies still around? See the risks for your pet.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a real risk in Brazil, despite vaccination campaigns that reduced—but did not eradicate—its occurrence. The virus attacks the central nervous system and is almost always fatal once symptoms appear; there is no effective treatment. Transmission occurs primarily via saliva from infected animals, most commonly through bites, but also via contact with mucous membranes or open wounds, and occasionally contaminated scratches. After entry, the virus travels along nerves to the brain, with incubation time varying. Clinical signs reflect CNS involvement and include behavioral changes, aggression, difficulty swallowing, and loss of motor coordination, rapidly progressing to paralysis and death. In Brazil, wildlife reservoirs, especially bats, increasingly encroach on urban areas and homes, elevating risk for pets, even those kept indoors. Vaccination remains the principal preventive measure, reducing viral circulation; booster doses are essential, and under-vaccinating indoor pets is a mistaken risk assumption.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病はまだ存在するのか？ペットのリスクを見てください
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで狂犬病の持続的なリスクが報告されており、野生動物貯蔵池（特にコウモリ）の都市エリアへの浸潤拡大が言及されている。しかし記事は主に公衆衛生啓発・教育的な性質であり、新規アウトブレイク報告や具体的な患者数などの具体的イベント情報が不明。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病のリスク啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや具体的患者数の報告ではない。WPRO基準で重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさに該当するが、公衆衛生的な緊急性を示す具体的なイベント（患者発生・死亡事例の増加など）が記載されていない。継続監視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Australian cows help Indonesia's slow recovery from FMD outbreak
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreak in Indonesia in 2022 caused mass cattle deaths and eradication programs, costing about IDR 9.9 trillion (~$6.6 billion). As recovery continues, Australia’s Indo Dairy program (ACIAR: Indo Dairy 1, $2 million; Indo Dairy 2, $3.7 million) aims to lift Indonesia’s milk supply by 25% and boost incomes for about 3,000 dairy producers in West Java and North Sumatra, including village co-ops. On a farm south of Jakarta, Ma’mur M. Komara and Eneng Maesaroh run 41 cattle, with 12 milking cows; milk processed on-site into mozzarella, yoghurt, and pasteurised dairy. The program funds training and education—dairy management schools (since 2011) and village researchers (five university-trained) facilitating groups that increased milk output since 2018; aims to improve milk quality and animal health. Indonesia’s government has lifted the food-security budget 45% and pursues school-meals milk for 82 million people by 2029.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリアの牛がインドネシアの口蹄疫アウトブレイクからの遅い回復を支援
triage.triage_reason: 2022年のインドネシア口蹄疫は既に過去のイベントであり、現在の記事は回復支援プログラムの進捗を報じているもの。新規の感染症危機ではなく、歴史的イベントの経済的影響報告である。
triage.notes: 記事は2022年のインドネシア口蹄疫アウトブレイクについて言及していますが、これは過去のイベントです。現在の記事は、オーストラリア援助プログラムによる復興支援を報じているもので、新規の感染症危機ではありません。シグナルトリアージの対象外として判定します。

article.articleHeadline: اليمن خامس العالم في إصابات الكوليرا.. 3,177 حالة و3 وفيات في 3 أشهر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yemen ranks fifth worldwide in cholera cases: 3,177 cases and 3 deaths in 3 months.
article.articleSummary: Cholera and acute watery diarrhea cases continue to surge in Yemen. WHO reports 3,177 suspected cases with 3 confirmed deaths from January 1 to March 29, 2026. Yemen ranks fifth worldwide by total cases, behind the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan, Mozambique, and South Sudan. In the Eastern Mediterranean region, Yemen has the second-highest burden after Afghanistan, with 24,009 regional cases and 9 deaths since the start of 2026. In March alone, 969 new cases and 2 deaths were reported in Yemen, contributing to its position as the fourth-highest monthly case count globally. Globally, the first quarter of 2026 saw 58,740 cholera and acute watery diarrhea cases and 732 deaths across 22 countries. The data underscore ongoing health-system fragility and the public-health risk amid Yemen’s protracted conflict, with no details on infection source or import/export cases.

triage.headline_ja: イエメンがコレラで世界5位：3ヶ月で3,177例と3人の死亡者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な多国間拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準4つ以上該当。複数国での流行が確認され、シグナル特性を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイエメンのコレラ流行を主題としており、複数国（DRC、アフガニスタン、モザンビーク、南スーダン）での流行に言及しているが、対象国リストの該当は DRC のみ。イエメン、スーダン、アフガニスタン、モザンビーク、グリースは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations に追加されない。2026年第1四半期の全世界58,740例、732死亡は明らかに深刻な多国間流行であり、東地中海地域での急速な増加傾向、脆弱な保健システムという背景が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Síndrome respiratória grave mata 438 em MG | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe respiratory syndrome kills 438 in Minas Gerais | G1
article.articleSummary: Severe acute respiratory syndrome has caused 438 deaths in Minas Gerais this year, per municipal health secretariats; Belo Horizonte accounts for 172. The state faces low vaccination uptake, with only 24% of the target group immunized after about a month, and roughly 35% in the capital. The SUS vaccine protects against the viruses H1N1, H3N2 and influenza, and is offered to children 6 months to 6 years, the elderly, pregnant people, healthcare workers, people with disabilities, some education staff, Indigenous peoples, quilombolas, people in detention, truck drivers and other priority groups. In Contagem, low coverage reflects on the health network, with ICU beds about 90% occupied. The Ministry of Health urges expanding vaccine access beyond health posts, and notes misinformation, especially among the elderly. Initiatives include a National Vaccination Day, SMS reminders to seniors, and school campaigns to vaccinate children up to six years.

triage.headline_ja: 重篤呼吸器症候群がミナスジェライス州で438人を殺害
triage.triage_reason: H1N1/H3N2インフルエンザウイルスによる死亡438例が報告され、ワクチン接種率が低い（24%）中で感染が継続している。重症度が高く、管理可能性に課題がある。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州での季節性インフルエンザ流行。死亡438例、ワクチン接種率が目標の24%にとどまり、ICU占有率が約90%に達している。保健省が対応を強化中。WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当（異常性は低いが重症度・継続的曝露・流行性・管理課題あり）のため PICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Planta brasileira destrói até 93% do vírus da COVID em testes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Brazilian plant destroys up to 93% of the COVID-19 virus in tests.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian Copaifera lucens leaf compounds show potent antiviral activity against SARS-CoV-2, neutralizing up to 93% of the COVID-19 virus in vitro. Leaves studied were collected at the Rio de Janeiro Botanic Garden. Researchers led by Jairo K. Bastos at the University of São Paulo, with collaborators from Egypt, the Czech Republic, and Spain, identified galloylquinic acids (GQAs) as the active agents. The study reports a triple-action mechanism, acting at three points in the viral life cycle, a feature that may reduce resistance compared with single-target antivirals. The compounds exhibit a high selectivity index (~102), indicating effective antiviral activity with limited toxicity to human cells in experiments. Remdesivir and Molnupiravir have SI values between 30 and 80 for comparison. Findings are preliminary—based on in vitro work and computational simulations—so preclinical and human trials are still needed. Funded by FAPESP, the work underscores Brazil’s biodiversity as a resource for global health.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの植物がテストで新型コロナウイルスの最大93%を破壊
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究段階（in vitro試験）の報告であり、実際の感染症イベント（患者発生、感染拡大、公衆衛生上の危機）ではなく、科学研究成果のニュースである。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当せず、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は植物由来化合物のin vitro抗ウイルス活性に関する基礎研究報告。実際の感染症イベント（患者発生、流行など）ではなく、創薬研究段階の成果ニュースであるため、感染症危機管理のシグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Diario HOY | Advierten crisis por tuberculosis en cárceles y plantean emergencia sanitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HOY Daily | Warn of a Tuberculosis Crisis in Prisons and Call for a Health Emergency.
article.articleSummary: TB crisis in Paraguay's prisons escalates due to uncontrolled tuberculosis transmission in critically overcrowded facilities. Inmates have up to 30 times higher risk of TB than people outside. The situation is worsened by overcrowding—over 300% in some facilities—poor ventilation, late diagnoses, and interruptions to treatment. Penitentiaries highlighted include Tacumbú National Penitentiary and centers in Ciudad del Este and San Pedro, environments deemed conducive to rapid spread and capable of affecting staff, visitors, and nearby communities. The issue is presented as both a health emergency and a human rights concern, with the State responsible for safeguarding the life and health of detainees. Proposed responses include a 90-day intervention plan for the most critical prisons, an emergency health law for penitentiaries, actions to reduce overcrowding, and protection programs for correctional officers. TB is curable; indifference is not.

triage.headline_ja: 獄中結核危機警告と保健上の緊急事態を提言（パラグアイ）
triage.triage_reason: 結核の深刻な集団発生がパラグアイの獄中で報告されており、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当し、国民的関心が高い。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度・流行性・管理可能性が確認される。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに Philippines（1694008）と Paraguay（3437598）が含まれているが、記事サマリーを読むと、主題はパラグアイの獄中結核危機である。記事の詳細地名（Tacumbú National Penitentiary、Ciudad del Este、San Pedro）はすべてパラグアイの施設を指していることから、実際の発生国はパラグアイである。パラグアイは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列となる。ただし、公衆衛生上の影響が深刻であり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準ともに複数該当するため、PICKUPと判定される。CEPR対象国外でのシグナルだが、結核という監視対象疾患かつ集団発生のため、関連機関への情報提供推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta! Bebês menores de 1 ano concentram casos de coqueluche no Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert! Infants under 1 year account for pertussis cases in Acre.
article.articleSummary: Pertussis (whooping cough) in Acre, Brazil, as of Week 17, 2026: 23 notifications, 3 confirmed, 11 discarded; others under investigation. In 2025 there were 25 notifications with 14 confirmations, mainly in Rio Branco (9), Xapuri, Porto Acre, Senador Guiomard. In 2026, confirmed cases are in Rio Branco (2) and Sena Madureira (1). Infants under 1 year are the most vulnerable; most confirmations in 2025–2026 occurred in this age group, predominantly boys, with isolated cases in 5–9-year-olds, adolescents, and adults. Pertussis is a contagious respiratory infection transmitted by airborne droplets; early symptoms resemble a cold, followed by severe coughing, potentially causing pneumonia, dehydration, apnea, or death in infants. Prevention relies on vaccination: pentavalent at 2, 4, 6 months, boosters at 15 months and 4 years; pregnant women should receive dTpa from 20 weeks. Seek care for persistent cough or breathing difficulties; avoid contact with newborns and keep spaces ventilated.

triage.headline_ja: アラート！アクレ州で1歳未満の乳幼児が百日咳症例の集中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのアクレ州における百日咳の地域的発生報告。情報が限定的（確定症例が少数、感染経路や学校・医療施設での集団発生の記載がない）であるが、乳幼児への高い脆弱性と呼吸器病原体の特性から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 百日咳は高い感染性を持つ呼吸器感染症であり、乳幼児における重症化リスク（肺炎、脱水、無呼吸、死亡）が指摘されている。アクレ州内の複数地域で2025～2026年に症例が確認されており、継続的な監視が推奨される。IHR基準は満たしていないが、スクリーニング基準3項目該当のため経過観察。

article.articleHeadline: バングラデシュ、はしか急拡大 ３月以降２８０人死亡｜全国のニュース｜Web東奥
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangladesh: Measles outbreak expanding rapidly; 280 deaths since March.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh is expanding rapidly. From March 15 to May 1, 2026, 280 deaths and more than 38,000 suspected cases have been reported. The World Health Organization cautions that infection could spread to neighboring India and Myanmar. The surge began in January at Cox’s Bazar, southeastern Bangladesh, in a refugee camp hosting Rohingya from Myanmar, and has since spread nationwide. Bangladesh relied on UNICEF-provided measles vaccines for 9- and 15-month-old children, but vaccination has faced disruption after a September shift by the Yunus interim government to open-tender procurement, causing supply shortages. Measles is highly contagious; incubation is about 10 days, with fever, cough, runny nose, and rash, and it can progress to encephalitis. The report underscores vaccination gaps and the regional transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュ、はしか急拡大 ３月以降２８０人死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。バングラデシュで大規模なはしか流行が発生し、280人の死亡と38,000人以上の疑似患者が報告されており、インドとミャンマーへの地域的拡大リスクが明記されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは、バングラデシュでのはしか流行が「インドとミャンマーへの感染拡大リスク」を明示的に述べているため、3国すべてを verified_locations に含めた。ロヒンギャ難民キャンプから発生し、全国規模に拡大した点、ワクチン供給の中断という管理上の課題、および脳炎への進展可能性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Healthcare providers to report every new case of leprosy: Delhi govt
article.articleSummary: Leprosy will be declared a notifiable disease under the Delhi Epidemic Diseases Act, mandating all healthcare providers in Delhi to report every new leprosy case to the District Leprosy Officer. The Delhi government announced the measure on Friday, May 1, 2026, with the aim of strengthening surveillance, enabling early detection, and improving treatment compliance across the national capital. The measure seeks to standardize reporting, facilitate timely public health responses, and monitor incidence trends. No laboratory-confirmation details or case counts are provided in the report. The policy underscores enhanced surveillance and case management within Delhi, potentially influencing future public health planning and resource allocation for leprosy control.

triage.headline_ja: デリー政府、ハンセン病の全新規症例報告を医療提供者に義務付け
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は既知疾患であり、本記事は行政的な通知義務化の発表に過ぎず、新規の流行や急増の報告ではない。ただし監視強化の方針が示されており、今後の実際の症例数増加への注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は新規の感染症クラスターや流行を報告するものではなく、既知疾患（ハンセン病）の行政的な監視強化政策の発表である。症例数、重症度、死亡については情報がない。今後、報告義務化に伴い症例数が増加した場合の続報に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Em meio à alta de dengue, até posto de saúde tem focos do mosquito em Campo Grande
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid the dengue outbreak, even a health post has mosquito breeding sites in Campo Grande.
article.articleSummary: Dengue and chikungunya outbreaks are unfolding in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with Campo Grande's Tiradentes neighborhood reporting mosquito breeding at a health post (USF Doutor Antônio Pereira) due to stagnant water and a sewer leak. Larvae of Aedes aegypti were seen in standing water near the gate. State-wide data show 4,818 probable dengue cases in 2026, and Campo Grande has 37 probable dengue cases (4.1 per 100,000), as part of an overall incidence of 173.3 per 100,000. First quarter 2026 dengue cases dropped 76% versus 2025, but April data showed a 1.5% year-over-year rise. Chikungunya surged, with 1,295 probable cases added in the last week; 2026 totals reach 3,997 confirmed and 4,897 awaiting lab results (8,894 probable). At least 14 chikungunya deaths in MS, including nine in Dourados; two more under investigation. Public health advice emphasizes removing standing water and routine vector-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の流行の中、保健所でも蚊の繁殖地が確認されたカンポグランデ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とチクングニアの同時発生がブラジル・マト・グロッソ・ド・スル州で報告されており、チクングニアで14人の死亡（9人はドゥラドスで確認）が記録されているため重症度基準を満たす。ただし、具体的な国家レベルの対応状況や国際的な拡大リスクについての情報が不足しているため、続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: チクングニアの急増（前週比1,295例）と14人の死亡報告が注目される。デング熱との同時流行が確認されており、保健施設内での蚊の繁殖も報告されている。ただしBrazilはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため、この評価はCEPRの対象外であることに留意。

article.articleHeadline: [Video] Bộ Y tế yêu cầu điều tra vụ 46 người nghi ngộ độc thực phẩm tại Quảng Trị
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Video] Ministry of Health requests investigation into the incident involving 46 people suspected of food poisoning in Quảng Trị Province
article.articleSummary: On May 1, 2026, Vietnam's Ministry of Health called for an investigation into an incident in Quảng Trị Province involving 46 people suspected of food poisoning; no confirmed causative agent or laboratory results are reported in the article. The case prompts immediate outbreak investigation, source tracing, and appropriate clinical management of patients. Separately, the MOH announced measures to ensure emergency care during two upcoming holiday periods and touched on broader health-system strengthening, including proposed staffing updates for commune health stations. The report also commemorates World Malaria Day (April 25) and reiterates Vietnam's goal to eliminate malaria by 2030, reflecting continued attention to mosquito-borne disease control. Other items include policy notes on population support, but the primary infectious-disease focus remains the Quảng Trị incident and malaria-elimination commitment.

triage.headline_ja: 【動画】保健省がクアンチ省の46人の食中毒疑い事件の調査を要請
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒の疑い事例（46人）で確定原因不明だが、東南アジア対象国ベトナムで報告されており、スクリーニング基準に1つ以上該当する可能性がある。ただし確定情報が不足しているため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は食中毒疑い事例（46人、原因未確定）であり、マラリアはWHO記念日関連の背景情報として言及されているのみ。Bluedot APIが疾患名として『Malaria』を付与しているのは誤分類と考えられる。確定診断・原因物質の特定、症状の重症度などが記事に記載されていないため情報不足。ベトナムでの食中毒集団発生は異常事象であり、公式調査の対象となっているため関心は高いが、確定データの入手まで経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19, sốt xuất huyết và chân tay miệng tăng mạnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Covid-19, dengue fever, and hand, foot, and mouth disease are on the rise.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever rose to 6,408 cases with 1 death in April nationwide; since mid-December 2025 total dengue approaches 45,000, up 1.8× year-on-year, with two more deaths, as monsoon raises mosquito risk. HFMD: over 11,800 cases in April and 3 deaths; cumulative 34,432 since late 2025, up 2.5×, remaining the most affected infectious disease in children and stressing pediatric facilities. The south region bears the strongest surge; EV71 virus is circulating at high rates, linked to severe pediatric complications. Covid-19: 302 cases in April; total since late 2025 to date 356, about 4.4× the previous year, with few severe cases so far. Influenza: about 17,900 cases in April, no deaths, down ~15% year-on-year. Rabies: 20 deaths this year. No cases of Nipah, avian influenza A/H5N1, cholera, or diphtheria in April. Measures: strengthen surveillance, vaccine supply for the Expanded Immunization Program, improve legal framework, hygiene, and rainy-season control.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルス、デング熱、手足口病が急増
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症の同時流行（デング熱、手足口病、COVID-19）が報告されており、デング熱は前年比1.8倍、手足口病は2.5倍と顕著な増加傾向を示している。EV71による小児の重症合併症が報告され、小児医療施設への負荷が増加している。IHR基準では「異常性」と「深刻な公衆衛生影響」が認められ、WPROスクリーニングでも複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 複数の感染症が同時流行中で、特にデング熱（南部で最も顕著）と手足口病（EV71ウイルス）が小児を中心に重症例を生じている。ベクター媒介感染症および直接感染症の双方が流行しており、雨期に向けた対策強化が言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: 北京疾控提醒您，踏青游玩做好防护，防止蜱虫叮咬
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beijing CDC reminds you to take precautions during spring outings to prevent tick bites.
article.articleSummary: Beijing CDC warns during the May Day holiday to guard against tick bites as ticks emerge with spring warming in northern China. Ticks (hard and soft) can transmit viruses, bacteria, and parasites that cause diseases such as Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS), tick-borne encephalitis, and Lyme disease. High-risk activities include outdoor outings in suburbs, mountains, grasslands, and camps; ticks are active in mornings and evenings, with adults peaking April–June and nymphs July–September. Protection tips: avoid tick habitats; wear long sleeves and tucked pants; choose light-colored, smooth fabrics; apply repellents containing DEET or picaridin; use pyrethroid treatments on tents and camping gear. If bitten, remove with pointed tweezers by pulling straight up, disinfect the wound, and preserve the tick for hospital testing; seek medical care if fever or rash develops. Check pets after outings; manage stray cats/dogs to reduce infestations; monitor health after traveling from tick areas.

triage.headline_ja: 北京疾控提醒您，踏青游玩做好防护，防止蜱虫叮咬
triage.triage_reason: 蜱虫媒介疾患に関する予防啓発記事であり、新規発生事例の報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当せず、社会的関心も通常の季節性予防情報の範囲内。
triage.notes: 本記事は北京衛生委員会による季節的な蜱虫咬傷予防のための啓発通知であり、感染症の発生報告ではない。SFTS、ライム病、蜱媒介脳炎といった疾患への言及があるが、これらはリスク情報（こうした疾患が蜱によって媒介される可能性がある）の提示に過ぎず、実際の患者発生や異常な流行の報告ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Raiva humana provocou morte de adolescente após mordida de sagui
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human rabies killed a teenager after a squirrel monkey bite.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Piauí, Brazil: a 17-year-old boy from rural Oeiras died in Teresina on April 17 after being bitten by a sagui (squirrel monkey) in Oeiras. Laboratory confirmation by Instituto Pasteur was released on April 29, 2026. Symptoms appeared about 40 days after the bite, including disorientation, vomiting and fever. Sesapi reported epidemiological surveillance and control measures with the local municipality to prevent further cases. Public health guidance urges immediate wound washing with water and soap, seeking medical evaluation for post-exposure prophylaxis, and not handling the animal; vaccination of dogs and cats is emphasized as prevention. The previous human rabies case in Piauí occurred in 2024 in Piripiri. Rabies is a viral disease transmitted mainly through saliva via animal bites; incubation can reach up to 45 days, with early symptoms such as malaise, fever, and headache, progressing to seizures and death.

triage.headline_ja: 人間狂犬病がリスザルの咬傷後に10代少年の死亡をもたらした
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ピアウイ州での確定狂犬病死亡例であり、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「深刻な公衆衛生影響」に該当。動物由来感染症の人間への伝播確認であり、地域的な再発防止対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は通常WPROの対象外だが、本記事はブラジル内の野生動物（リスザル）からの人間への伝播確認であり、Instituto Pasteurによる検査室確認済み。2024年のピアウイ州での前回例との時系列から地域的な動物狂犬病の継続が示唆される。ただし国際拡大の直接的リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh não mô cầu gia tăng:Trẻ dưới 15 tuổi đối mặt nguy cơ cao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal disease on the rise: Children under 15 at high risk.
article.articleSummary: Neisseria meningitidis meningococcal disease is resurging in Vietnam. From January to March 2026, 24 cases and 4 deaths were reported nationwide, with children under 15 making up 46% of cases. The dual risk is clear: young children are highly susceptible to infection and carriage, while adolescents contribute to transmission in schools, dormitories, and other crowd settings. Most cases present as meningitis (>50%) or fulminant septicemia (5–20%), though pneumonia, conjunctivitis, and other forms occur. Without timely treatment, mortality can reach 50%; even with intervention, 10–15% die and about 20% of survivors have long-term sequelae such as deafness, brain injury, kidney failure, or cognitive impairment. Vaccination is the key preventive measure. Vietnam currently circulates serogroups A, B, C, Y, and W; vaccines protect only specific groups, so full vaccination against multiple serogroups, including B, is recommended for young children, students, and teenagers in crowded settings to curb disease and carriage.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌病が増加：15歳未満の子どもが高リスク
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで髄膜炎菌病が再興し、2026年1月〜3月に24例4死亡が報告されている。IHR基準では重症度（死亡率10-50%、後遺症20%）と異常性（再興）で2基準該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度、異常性、流行性、管理可能性で複数基準該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム国内のメディア（baolaocai.vn）が配信。2026年という将来の日付となっているが、データとして提供されたため記事のとおり評価。複数血清群（A、B、C、Y、W）の循環、15歳未満で46%を占める、学校・寮での集団感染リスク、高い死亡率と後遺症率がリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi moves to declare leprosy a notifiable disease to strengthen surveillance
article.articleSummary: Delhi moves to declare leprosy a notifiable disease under the Delhi Epidemic Diseases Act as of 2026-05-02. If approved, guidelines will require reporting every new leprosy case to the District Leprosy Officer by all government and private healthcare providers, including clinics, hospitals, and individual doctors. The aim is to improve tracking, enable early detection, and ensure patients receive timely Multi-Drug Therapy, available free in government facilities. India eliminated leprosy as a public health problem in 2005, but accounts for about 59% of global annual new cases. A pan-India study found 44.1% of patients are managed by private facilities and go unreported to the National Leprosy Eradication Programme, creating hidden pockets of infection. Experts say making leprosy notifiable will enhance surveillance, standardize treatment, reduce drug resistance, and help reduce stigma.

triage.headline_ja: デリーが感染症対策の強化に向けてハンセン病を届出対象疾患に指定へ
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は慢性感染症で、単一事象としてのイベント性は限定的。政策変更（届出義務化）は公衆衛生対策の強化を示すが、急性のアウトブレイクではなく、その後の経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントは新規アウトブレイクではなく、既知の慢性疾患（インドは全球新規患者の59%を占める）に対する公衆衛生政策（届出義務化）の導入事例。WPROスクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」に該当（未報告患者が44.1%存在）するが、政府主導の対策強化であり、緊急シグナルではない。続報で実装後の症例報告数の動向を注視する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: 大爷徒手抓蝙蝠直接进ICU：感染汉坦病毒 出现严重肾损伤
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elderly man who caught a bat with his bare hands was rushed to the ICU: Hantaan virus infection with severe kidney injury.
article.articleSummary: May 2, 2026, in Chaohu, Anhui Province, China, reports a single hantavirus infection case causing hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) in an elderly man. To protect his wife, he captured a bat with bare hands and released it outdoors. A few days later he developed sudden high fever, progressive leg weakness, unsteady gait, and acute urinary retention, prompting urgent hospital care and escalation to the intensive care unit. Specialists diagnosed hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome triggered by hantavirus, a disease with fever, hemorrhage, and kidney injury, often accompanied by facial, neck, and chest flushing—the “three reds.” The virus can cause rapid renal deterioration and may be life-threatening if not treated promptly. This report describes a domestic case with no indication of an wider outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 素手でコウモリを捕まえた老人が直接ICUに：ハンタウイルス感染、重度の腎損傷を発症
triage.triage_reason: 散発例で重症度は高いがアウトブレイクの兆候がなく、国際的拡大リスクも明記なし。情報が限定的なため経過観察に留める。
triage.notes: IHR基準は2つ該当し本来PICKUPの閾値だが、記事サマリーが『wider outbreak の兆候なし』と明記されており、散発例扱い。WPRO基準でも異常性と重症度は認められるが、流行しやすさと管理の困難性は低い。社会的関心（メディア報道）はあるが、情報制限国での公式政府対応状況は不明。追加情報待ちの判定。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de raiva em morcego é confirmado em Cacoal; saiba como se prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies case in a bat confirmed in Cacoal; learn how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a bat on the campus of the Federal Institute of Rondônia (IFRO) in Cacoal, Rondônia, Brazil. The animal exhibited abnormal behavior, including difficulty flying, and had direct contact with students who are being monitored. After capture, the bat was sent to the Central Laboratory of Public Health of Rondônia (Lacen) in Porto Velho; lab confirmation of the rabies virus was announced in March 2026. The virus continues circulating in the region in both urban and rural areas. Environmental Surveillance has initiated a containment block with reinforced vaccination within a 12 km radius of the discovery site. Reporting animals with atypical behavior remains essential to prevent new cases and protect students and the broader community.

triage.headline_ja: カコアルで確認されたコウモリの狂犬病ケース；自分を守る方法を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのロンドニア州でコウモリから確認された狂犬病は、学生との直接接触があり管理可能性に懸念があるが、現時点では死亡例や大規模人間感染の報告がなく、情報が限定的である。
triage.notes: コウモリの狂犬病確認は異常/予想外であり、学生との直接接触と地域でのウイルス循環により曝露リスクが存在する。ただし現時点で人間感染例の報告がなく、ワクチン接種による対応が実施されているため、スクリーニング基準1つ以上該当だが情報不足のためWATCHと判定。対象国リストに含まれるBrazilで発生。

article.articleHeadline: Muncul Lebih dari 700 Ribu Kasus Malaria, Kemenkes Siapkan Penanggulangan Eliminasi Hingga 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More Than 700,000 Malaria Cases: Ministry of Health Prepares Elimination Efforts Through 2030.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Indonesia surpassed 700,000 cases through 2025, up from about 543,000 in prior years, driven by population mobility and weather that affect Anopheles mosquitoes. Papua accounts for roughly 95% of transmission. Despite the surge, progress toward elimination persists, with 412 of 512 districts/cities malaria-free (~80%). Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites and transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes; common symptoms include high fever, chills, headaches, and body aches. High-risk groups include people living in or traveling to endemic areas, those near standing water, and individuals active outdoors at night. Control measures combine health services with behavior change: removing standing water, using bed nets, applying mosquito repellents, and sealing vents with mesh; larvicides, larvivorous fish, and anti-mosquito plants such as lemongrass and lavender are used. Remaining challenges are hard-to-reach forest areas and outbreaks in previously malaria-free zones. Strategic steps emphasize epidemiological investigations, migrant surveys, and cross-sector collaboration to achieve 2030 elimination.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア患者数70万人を超える、保健省が2030年までの排除対策を準備
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでマラリア患者が大幅に増加し、複数のWPRO基準に該当するが、情報が既知の流行対応であり、国内管理の範囲内と判断される。社会的関心は存在するが、国際的拡大リスクの具体的根拠が限定的。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではインドネシアのマラリア増加が主題。パプアニューギニアは発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリーではインドネシア（特にパプア州が95%の伝播）が焦点であり、パプアニューギニアでの具体的発症報告はない。IHR基準は2つ以上該当するが、既知の流行への公式対応であり、突発的な新規脅威の兆候は限定的。マラリアの風土的流行であり、WATCH段階での注視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Virus Penyebab Cacar Air "Tidur" di Tubuh, Bisa Bangun Jadi Cacar Api
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The varicella-zoster virus lies dormant in the body and can awaken to cause shingles.
article.articleSummary: Varicella-zoster virus (VZV) remains dormant in nerve tissue after chickenpox and can reactivate later as shingles (herpes zoster). In Jakarta, Dr. Vito A. Damay explains that the virus lodges near the spine and re-emerges when immunity declines. Distinct from chickenpox, shingles begins with severe, often unilateral pain without early fever or rash, and can be misinterpreted as heart or abdominal problems. A few days after the pain starts, vesicular lesions appear in the painful area, potentially disrupting daily activities. The briefing occurred during World Immunization Week activities in Indonesia, held with GSK on 28 April 2026, highlighting awareness that shingles is a reactivation of VZV rather than a new infection. In Indonesian medical terminology, shingles is also known as herpes zoster, cacar ular, or dompo.

triage.headline_ja: 水痘を引き起こすウイルスが体内で「潜伏」し、後に帯状疱疹として再活性化する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドネシアのジャカルタで開催された予防接種週間イベント中の医学的説明であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。水痘帯状疱疹ウイルスの生物学的特性に関する教育情報であり、公衆衛生的な危機や異常な流行を示唆していない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは予防接種週間（World Immunization Week）の啓発活動の一部であり、医学的な教育説明である。記事はジャカルタの医師による一般的な医学情報の提供を報道したもので、具体的な患者数、入院、死亡、異常な流行などの記載はない。帯状疱疹自体は周知の再活性化疾患であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: H5N1 avian flu confirmed in peacock deaths in Karnataka's Tumakuru, villages under surveillance
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza confirmed in about 40 wild peacocks that died over 10 days in the second week of April in Tumakuru district, Karnataka, with laboratory confirmation by NIHSAD, Bhopal. Six farmers were treated symptomatically and quarantined at home, alongside 26 forest officials who had handled carcasses. Kolihalli forest, in Urdigere hobli, reported peacock deaths on April 16. A rapid response team was deployed and five villages within a 10-km radius (Kolihalli, Ullenahalli, Bommanahalli, Bhyirasandra, Kallalli) are under intensive surveillance. Meat and chicken shops have been closed; officials from forest, animal husbandry, health, Gram Panchayat and revenue are conducting public awareness. Residents are urged to report unusual poultry deaths to the Smart City Control Room. Wildlife likely the source, with no confirmed spread to domestic animals; as of May 2, 2026, no additional peacock deaths reported.

triage.headline_ja: カルナタカ州トゥマクルでH5N1鳥インフルエンザがクジャクの死亡で確認、村は監視下に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性、重症度、国際的拡大リスク）。H5N1確定例、野生動物から人への感染リスク、複数州での検出。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: H5N1は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。約40羽のクジャク死亡、6名の農民と26名の森林職員が曝露。複数州（カルナタカ、テランガーナ、マディヤプラデシュ）での検出情報含まれる。野生動物が感染源とされているが、家畜への拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の潜在的リスクがあり、国際的警戒が必要。記事日付2026年5月は未来日であるが、提供されたデータとして処理。

article.articleHeadline: ಮಲೇರಿಯಾ ಅಥವಾ ಡೆಂಗೆ: ಯಾವುದೆಂದು ಹೇಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕು? ತಡೆಗಟ್ಟುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria or Dengue: How to tell which one it is? How to prevent it?
article.articleSummary: Malaria in New Delhi and other malaria-endemic areas is caused by Plasmodium via Anopheles mosquitoes; dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and can occur wherever mosquitoes exist. Malaria symptoms include fever, nausea, sweating, headache, muscle pains, abdominal upset, and vomiting. Dengue features abrupt high fever, severe headache, eye pain, body aches, backache, and may progress with thrombocytopenia (low platelets). Both diseases require blood tests for confirmation. Malaria treatment targets Plasmodium (e.g., chloroquine and other antimalarials); dengue has no specific antiviral—management is supportive, with emphasis on hydration and monitoring platelets. Prevention centers on eliminating standing water, indoor mosquito control, repellents, nets, and protective clothing. With rising mosquito activity in summer, timely diagnosis and vector-control remain essential to reduce morbidity and fatalities in New Delhi and surrounding regions as of May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアまたはデング熱：どちらであるか判別する方法は？予防方法は？
triage.triage_reason: 記事は既知の感染症（マラリア・デング熱）の臨床的識別と予防方法に関する教育的コンテンツであり、新規の流行事象や異常な健康イベントではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はNew Delhinでのマラリア・デング熱の識別と予防に関する一般的な教育記事である。具体的な流行事象、異常な症例増加、新興パターン、または制御困難な状況についての報告はない。医学知識の提供に過ぎず、シグナルトリアージの対象となる感染症危機を示さない。

article.articleHeadline: Karnataka: 40 peacocks dead due to H5N1 virus in Tumkur, people advised to consume well-cooked, boiled meat
article.articleSummary: About 40 peacocks have died from H5N1 avian influenza in Tumkur district, Karnataka, India. A 10-km containment zone has been declared around the epicenter, with rapid-response teams conducting ongoing surveillance. The area includes around 31 poultry shops and 10 farms; samples from the birds were sent for testing and lab results confirmed H5N1 yesterday. Authorities urge calm and advise residents to consume only well-cooked and boiled meat. The WHO notes that avian influenza A (H5N1) primarily affects birds, with human infections being rare but potentially severe and highly fatal. The goose/Guangdong lineage emerged in 1996; since 2020 a variant has driven wild-bird and poultry deaths across Africa, Asia, and Europe. Containment and monitoring are continuing.

triage.headline_ja: カルナタカ州：トゥムクル地区でH5N1ウイルスにより孔雀40羽が死亡、市民に加熱・加水調理した肉の摂取を勧告
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの動物での確認事例。IHR基準において異常/予想外性と国際的拡大リスク（2020年以降のアジア・アフリカ・ヨーロッパでの広がり）に該当。WPRO基準でも異常性、長期曝露リスク（継続的な監視・封じ込め必要）、流行性（家禽との接触リスク）に該当し、シグナル認定基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、トゥムクル地区（カルナタカ州、インド）での孔雀群における H5N1 確定例。2020年以降の国際的流行パターンと地域的な継続的リスク、家禽施設との近接性（31の家禽店、10の農場が10km隔離区域内）を考慮し、シグナルとして認定。人での感染事例は報告されていないが、H5N1の人獣共通感染リスク管理上、監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ca giang mai tại TP HCM tăng gấp đôi sau 5 năm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Syphilis cases in Ho Chi Minh City have doubled over five years.
article.articleSummary: Syphilis cases in Ho Chi Minh City nearly doubled from 4,899 in 2020 to over 9,500 in 2025, prompting intensified screening at primary-care level. Males account for about threefold higher incidence than females. Treponema pallidum infection risk is linked to multiple partners and unprotected sex, with many cases progressing silently. Genital warts (condyloma acuminata) surpassed 38,000 cases in 2023; gonorrhea rising, with male cases more than 11 times female. The 2026 plan targets three goals: strengthen primary health-care capacity, reduce common STI burden, and eliminate mother-to-child transmission of syphilis. Challenges include workforce shortages and stigma delaying care; enhanced training and support for district clinics are planned. Leprosy control is successful, with district-level elimination by 2025, no new pediatric cases 2021–2025, and 246 patients under care; 2026 aims to maintain prevalence under 0.2 per 10,000 and ensure care for all disabled by leprosy.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市の梅毒患者数が5年間で2倍に増加
triage.triage_reason: 複数のSTI（性感染症）の増加傾向が報告されており、公衆衛生上の関心がある。ただし、感染症制御計画が進行中であり、国際的拡大リスクや深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が明確でないため、追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: ベトナムのホーチミン市において梅毒、淋病、尖圭コンジローマなどの複数のSTIが増加傾向を示している。特に梅毒は2020年の4,899件から2025年の9,500件以上に倍増し、男性患者が女性の3倍以上。国内の感染症制御計画が進行中であるが、医療人材不足とスティグマが課題。ハンセン病は制御に成功しており、2021-2025年に新規小児患者はない。記事は在来性の感染症増加を報告しており、異常な発生（outbreak）ではなく既知の疾患の増加傾向である。ただし複数のSTIの同時増加と持続的曝露があるため、経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Karnataka: H5N1 virus kills 40 peacocks in Tumkur; containment zone set
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-02, H5N1 avian influenza caused the deaths of about 40 peacocks in Tumkur district, Karnataka. A 10-km containment zone around the epicenter is under surveillance by rapid response teams. Samples from affected birds were sent for testing and laboratory confirmation of H5N1 was reported yesterday. Authorities identified about 31 poultry shops and 10 farms in the area for monitoring; additional samples from today’s deaths are being tested. Deputy Commissioner Subha Kalyan advised consuming only well-cooked and boiled meat and stated the district administration is ready. The WHO describes H5N1 as avian influenza that can infect birds and mammals, with human infections carrying high mortality.

triage.headline_ja: カルナータカ州：H5N1ウイルスがトゥムクルで40羽のクジャクを殺害、封鎖ゾーン設定
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの動物での確認、人間への感染リスク存在、国際的な感染症懸念、インドでの封鎖措置実施。IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: H5N1は高い死亡率を持つヒト感染病原体。動物での確認だが、ヒト感染リスク存在。地域当局が10km封鎖ゾーン設定し積極的対応。WHO記載の高リスク病原体。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: कर्नाटक में बर्ड फ्लू का खतरा... 44 मोरों की मौत; H5N1 वायरस की पुष्टि, अलर्ट जारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu threat in Karnataka... 44 peacocks dead; H5N1 virus confirmed, alert issued.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza H5N1 detected in Tumakuru district, Karnataka, after more than 44 peacocks died since 16 April. Laboratory testing at ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal confirmed H5N1 infection. A 10-km containment zone has been declared around the affected area to curb spread. Most cases were reported in Kesaramadu, Hirehalli, and Gulur Gram Panchayat areas; authorities have intensified surveillance with joint teams from the forest, health, and animal husbandry departments. Chief Conservator of Forests Kumar Pushkar directed poultry farm operators to tighten biosecurity; surveillance and guidelines were issued across poultry farms. The health department put hospitals on alert, ensuring PPE kits, masks, medicines, and testing supplies. No further peacock deaths have been reported since 23 April, according to administration.

triage.headline_ja: カルナータカ州で鳥インフルエンザの脅威... 44羽の孔雀が死亡; H5N1ウイルスの確認、警戒態勢発令
triage.triage_reason: H5N1ウイルス検査陽性の確認、複数地域での動物の大量死、IHR基準2項目以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準3項目以上該当、および高い社会的関心があるため。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・カルナータカ州トゥマクル地区での鳥インフルエンザH5N1検出を報告。44羽の孔雀死亡が確認され、ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseasesで実験室確認済み。10km隔離区域を設定し、複数部門による監視が実施されている。ただし人間への感染は記事中に報告されていない。
